3.5.13.b.d: दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आरभमानः पूर्वस्य पर्वण औपवसथ्ये ऽहनि चतुर्होतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य सग्रहम्̐ हुत्वा पूर्णा पश्चात् \\ यत् ते देवा अदधुस् \\ इति सारस्वतौ होमौ हुत्वा ।
3.5.13.b.m: Beginning the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, on the day of fasting of the preceding lunar day-juncture, having recited the Caturhotṛ formula mentally and offered with the cup-formula, having offered the two Sārasvata oblations with "Full behind..." [and] "What the gods placed in you...",

3.5.13.c.m: he pours out the introductory oblation.

3.5.13.d.s: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam̐ sarasvatyai carum̐ sarasvate dvādaśa kapālam agnaye bhagine 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yaḥ kāmayeta bhagy annādaḥ syām iti nityavad eke bhagine samāmananti /
3.5.13.d.d: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम्̐ सरस्वत्यै चरुम्̐ सरस्वते द्वादश कपालम् अग्नये भगिने ऽष्टाकपालं यः कामयेत भग्य् अन्नादः स्याम् इति नित्यवद् एके भगिने समामनन्ति ।
3.5.13.d.m: A cake on eleven potsherds for Agni-Viṣṇu, a mess of cooked grain for Sarasvatī, a cake on twelve potsherds for Sarasvat; a cake on eight potsherds for fortunate Agni for one who desires, "May I be fortunate and an eater of food"; some prescribe [it] as obligatory for fortunate [Agni].

3.5.13.e.s: purastāt sviṣṭakṛtas \\ cittaṃ ca svāhā cittiś ca svāhā \\ iti dvādaśagṛhītena dvādaśa jayāñ juhoti /
3.5.13.e.d: पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतस् \\ चित्तं च स्वाहा चित्तिश् च स्वाहा \\ इति द्वादशगृहीतेन द्वादश जयाञ् जुहोति ।
3.5.13.e.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the twelve Jaya oblations with twelve ladlings [of clarified butter], with "Thought, svāhā! Thinking, svāhā!"

3.5.13.f.m: The thirteenth with "Prajāpati [gave] the victories to Indra...".

3.5.13.g.s: agne balada saha oja ākramamāṇāya me 'dāḥ / abhiśastikṛte 'nabhiśastenyāyāsyai janatāyai śraiṣṭhyāya \\ iti caturdaśīṃ yāṃ janatāṃ dviṣyāt \\ citraṃ tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhavatu \\ iti śabalam iva tasyātmañ jāyate /
3.5.13.g.d: अग्ने बलद सह ओज आक्रममाणाय मे ऽदाः । अभिशस्तिकृते ऽनभिशस्तेन्यायास्यै जनतायै श्रैष्ठ्याय \\ इति चतुर्दशीं यां जनतां द्विष्यात् \\ चित्रं तस्यां जनतायां भवतु \\ इति शबलम् इव तस्यात्मञ् जायते ।
3.5.13.g.m: The fourteenth with "O Agni, giver of strength, you have given vigor and might to me advancing; for the cursed, for the uncursed, for the supremacy of this folk"; regarding whichever folk he might hate, [he thinks,] "Let there be variegation in that folk"; it is born, as it were, spotted in his self.

3.5.13.h.s: api vā nānvārambhaṇīyāṃ kurvītāgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
3.5.13.h.d: अपि वा नान्वारम्भणीयां कुर्वीताग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् ।
3.5.13.h.m: Or rather, he should not perform the introductory oblation; he should pour out an eight-potsherd cake for Agni.

3.5.13.i.m: For one who sets up the fires on a new moon, this is unmodified.

3.5.13.j.s: paurṇamāsyāṃ tu pūrvasya parvaṇa aupavasathye 'hany agnīn ādhāya seṣṭyapavṛjya /
3.5.13.j.d: पौर्णमास्यां तु पूर्वस्य पर्वण औपवसथ्ये ऽहन्य् अग्नीन् आधाय सेष्ट्यपवृज्य ।
3.5.13.j.m: On the full moon, however, on the day of fasting of the preceding lunar day-juncture, having set up the fires and concluded the sacrifice,

3.5.13.k.s: tadānīm eva caturhotāraṃ sārasvatau homāv anvārambhaṇīyāṃ ca kurute /
3.5.13.k.d: तदानीम् एव चतुर्होतारं सारस्वतौ होमाव् अन्वारम्भणीयां च कुरुते ।
3.5.13.k.m: at that very time he performs the Caturhotṛ formula, the two Sārasvata oblations, and the introductory oblation.

3.5.13.l.s: śvo bhūte paurṇamāsena yajate vyāhṛtībhir havīm̐ṣy āsādayati tathā saṃvatsare //
3.5.13.l.d: श्वो भूते पौर्णमासेन यजते व्याहृतीभिर् हवीम्̐ष्य् आसादयति तथा संवत्सरे ॥
3.5.13.l.m: On the next day, he sacrifices with the Full Moon rite; he sets down the sacrificial oblations with the mystical utterances; likewise for a whole year.

3.6.14.a.m: We shall explain the re-establishment [of the fires]; its procedure has been explained by the establishment of the fires.

3.6.14.b.s: agnīn ādhāyaitasmin saṃvatsare jyāniṃ putramartyāṃ vābhyeti svena vāṅgena virudhyate na vardhnoti sa punarādheyaṃ kurvīta /
3.6.14.b.d: अग्नीन् आधायैतस्मिन् संवत्सरे ज्यानिं पुत्रमर्त्यां वाभ्येति स्वेन वाङ्गेन विरुध्यते न वर्ध्नोति स पुनराधेयं कुर्वीत ।
3.6.14.b.m: Having established the fires, if within this year he incurs loss or the death of a son, or becomes impaired in his limb, or does not prosper, he should perform the re-establishment [of the fires].

3.6.14.c.s: paurṇamāsyeṣṭvāmāvāsyāyām āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam agnim udvāsayiṣyann ity ekeṣām /
3.6.14.c.d: पौर्णमास्येष्ट्वामावास्यायाम् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालम् अग्निम् उद्वासयिष्यन्न् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
3.6.14.c.m: Having sacrificed with the Full Moon rite, he should pour out on the new moon a cake on eight potsherds for Agni, [and] a cake on twelve potsherds for Vaiśvānara when intending to cast off the fire; thus say some.

3.6.14.d.s: agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālam anunirvaped agnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ maitraṃ carum /
3.6.14.d.d: अग्नीषोमीयम् एकादशकपालम् अनुनिर्वपेद् अग्नये ऽप्सुमते ऽष्टाकपालं मैत्रं चरुम् ।
3.6.14.d.m: He should pour out as subsequent offerings a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni-Soma, a cake on eight potsherds for watery Agni, and a mess of cooked grain for Mitra.

3.6.14.e.s: purastāt sviṣṭakṛto yā te agna utsīdataḥ pavamānā paśuṣu priyā tanūs tayā saha pṛthivīm āviśa rathaṃtareṇa sāmnā gāyatreṇa chandasā \ tato no maha āvaha \ yā te agne pāvakā yā manasā preyasī priyā tanūs tayā sahāntarikṣam āviśa vāmadevyena sāmnā traiṣṭubhena chandasā \ tato na ūrjam ākṛdhi gṛhamedhīyaṃ ca vardhaya \ yā te agne sūrye śuciḥ priyā tanūs tayā saha divam āviśa bṛhatā sāmnā jāgatena chandasā \ tato no vṛṣṭyāvadhi \ yās te agne vibhaktīs \\ indra sūkara ābhara \ tāsu śociṣu sīdeha \ bhasma vaiśvānarasya yat / \ yās te agne kāmadughās \\ vibhaktīr anusaṃbhṛtāḥ / \ tābhir naḥ kāmān dhukṣveha \ prajāṃ puṣṭim atho dhanam / \ ye te agne vānaspatyāḥ \ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ saha \ tebhir gaccha vanasptīn \ svāṃ yoniṃ yathātatham / \ agann agnir yathālokam \ asadat sadane sve / \ avīrahatyaṃ deveṣu \\ upāgāṃ manasā saha \\ iti saptāhutīr hutvā jvalato 'gnīn avasṛjati yāvad darśapūrṇamāsāv abhihutau tāvac ciram avasṛṣṭāgnir bhavati //
3.6.14.e.d: पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो या ते अग्न उत्सीदतः पवमाना पशुषु प्रिया तनूस् तया सह पृथिवीम् आविश रथंतरेण साम्ना गायत्रेण छन्दसा \ ततो नो मह आवह \ या ते अग्ने पावका या मनसा प्रेयसी प्रिया तनूस् तया सहान्तरिक्षम् आविश वामदेव्येन साम्ना त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा \ ततो न ऊर्जम् आकृधि गृहमेधीयं च वर्धय \ या ते अग्ने सूर्ये शुचिः प्रिया तनूस् तया सह दिवम् आविश बृहता साम्ना जागतेन छन्दसा \ ततो नो वृष्ट्यावधि \ यास् ते अग्ने विभक्तीस् \\ इन्द्र सूकर आभर \ तासु शोचिषु सीदेह \ भस्म वैश्वानरस्य यत् । \ यास् ते अग्ने कामदुघास् \\ विभक्तीर् अनुसंभृताः । \ ताभिर् नः कामान् धुक्ष्वेह \ प्रजां पुष्टिम् अथो धनम् । \ ये ते अग्ने वानस्पत्याः \ संभाराः संभृताः सह \ तेभिर् गच्छ वनस्प्तीन् \ स्वां योनिं यथातथम् । \ अगन्न् अग्निर् यथालोकम् \ असदत् सदने स्वे । \ अवीरहत्यं देवेषु \\ उपागां मनसा सह \\ इति सप्ताहुतीर् हुत्वा ज्वलतो ऽग्नीन् अवसृजति यावद् दर्शपूर्णमासाव् अभिहुतौ तावच् चिरम् अवसृष्टाग्निर् भवति ॥
3.6.14.e.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, having offered seven oblations with: "That purifying dear body of yours, O Agni, that departs among the beasts, enter the earth with it, with the Rathaṃtara Sāman, with the Gāyatrī metre; thence bring glory to us!" / "That purifying dear body of yours that is dearer to the mind, O Agni, enter the atmosphere with it, with the Vāmadevya Sāman, with the Triṣṭubh metre; thence make strength for us, and increase what belongs to the householder!" / "That pure dear body of yours in the sun, O Agni, enter heaven with it, with the Bṛhat Sāman, with the Jagatī metre; thence assist us with rain!" / "Those divided forms of yours, O Agni, that Indra, as a boar, brought; sit here in those flames, whatever is the ashes of Vaiśvānara!" / "Those wish-yielding divided forms of yours, O Agni, that have been gathered together; with them milk wishes here for us: offspring, nourishment, and wealth!" / "Those botanical materials of yours, O Agni, that have been collected together; with them go to the trees, to your own womb according to truth!" / "Agni has gone according to his world; he has sat in his own seat; harmless to heroes among the gods, I have approached along with my mind!" — he lets go of the burning fires; as long as the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are offered upon [them], for so long a time his fires remain cast off.

3.6.15.a.m: [He remains with his fires cast off] for a year or for twelve days.

3.6.15.b.m: Rohiṇī, Punarvasū, and Anūrādhās are the lunar mansions for the re-establishment.

3.6.15.c.m: He sets [them] up in the rainy season or in autumn.

3.6.15.f.m: He sets up the gārhapatya fire with all the Sārparājñī verses.

3.6.15.g.s: darbhair upolavaiḥ saṃvatsarapravātair gārhapatyād āhavanīyaṃ jvalantam uddharati /
3.6.15.g.d: दर्भैर् उपोलवैः संवत्सरप्रवातैर् गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयं ज्वलन्तम् उद्धरति ।
3.6.15.g.m: With darbhagrass stalks that have been dried by the wind for a year, he takes out the blazing fire from the gārhapatya fire for the āhavanīya fire.

3.6.15.h.s: yat tvā kruddhaḥ parovapa \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim ādadhāti yat te manyuparoptasya \\ ity āhavanīyam /
3.6.15.h.d: यत् त्वा क्रुद्धः परोवप \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् आदधाति यत् ते मन्युपरोप्तस्य \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
3.6.15.h.m: He establishes the dakṣiṇāgni fire with "When angry, I cast you away..."; the āhavanīya fire with "What [was cast away] of you who were thrown out by wrath...".

3.6.15.i.s: mano jyotir juṣatām ity āhitamā havanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
3.6.15.i.d: मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इत्य् आहितमा हवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते ।
3.6.15.i.m: With "May mind enjoy the light...", he reveres the established āhavanīya fire.

3.6.15.j.s: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām ity upasamindhe /
3.6.15.j.d: पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इत्य् उपसमिन्धे ।
3.6.15.j.m: With "May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus kindle you again!", he kindles it further.

3.6.15.k.s: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām ity upasamindhe punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām \\ punar brahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ / \ yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaś ca yājyās \ tāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena svāhā \\ ity āhutiṃ juhoti / mano jyotir juṣatām iti dvitīyām /
3.6.15.k.d: पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इत्य् उपसमिन्धे पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् \\ पुनर् ब्रह्माणो वसुनीथ यज्ञैः । \ या इष्टा उषसो निम्रुचश् च याज्यास् \ ताः संदधामि हविषा घृतेन स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहोति । मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इति द्वितीयाम् ।
3.6.15.k.m: With "May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus kindle you again!", he kindles it further; with "May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus kindle you again, again the priests with sacrifices, O bringer of goods! / Whatever dawns and sunsets have been sacrificed to, to which offering verses are addressed, those I unite with oblation, with ghee, svāhā!", he offers an oblation; a second one with "May mind enjoy the light...".

3.6.15.l.s: juhūm̐ sruvaṃ ca saṃmṛjya caturgṛhītenāṣṭagṛhītena dvādaśagṛhītena vā srucaṃ pūrayitvā sapta te \\ iti pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti /
3.6.15.l.d: जुहूम्̐ स्रुवं च संमृज्य चतुर्गृहीतेनाष्टगृहीतेन द्वादशगृहीतेन वा स्रुचं पूरयित्वा सप्त ते \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिं जुहोति ।
3.6.15.l.m: Having wiped the juhū and sruva ladles, and filled the ladle with four, eight, or twelve ladlings, he offers the full oblation with "Seven are your [kindling sticks]...".

3.6.15.m.s: āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ pañcakapālaṃ vāgnyādheyikasyāṣṭākapālasya sthāne nirvapati /
3.6.15.m.d: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं पञ्चकपालं वाग्न्याधेयिकस्याष्टाकपालस्य स्थाने निर्वपति ।
3.6.15.m.m: In place of the eight-potsherd cake of the establishment of the fires, he pours out a cake on eight potsherds or on five potsherds for Agni.

3.6.15.n.m: Everything in it is performed inaudibly up to the last after-offering.

3.6.15.o.s: agnāgne \\ agnāv agne \\ agnināgne \\ agnim agne \\ iti caturṣu prayājeṣu catasro vibhaktīr dadhāti purastād vaṣaṭkārāt /
3.6.15.o.d: अग्नाग्ने \\ अग्नाव् अग्ने \\ अग्निनाग्ने \\ अग्निम् अग्ने \\ इति चतुर्षु प्रयाजेषु चतस्रो विभक्तीर् दधाति पुरस्ताद् वषट्कारात् ।
3.6.15.o.m: "O Agni, in Agni...", "In Agni, O Agni...", "By Agni, O Agni...", "To Agni, O Agni..."—thus he introduces four grammatical case-inflections into four fore-offerings before the vaṣaṭ-call.

3.6.15.p.s: punar ūrjā \\ iti purastāt prayājānām āhutiṃ juhoty upariṣṭād eke samāmananti /
3.6.15.p.d: पुनर् ऊर्जा \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रयाजानाम् आहुतिं जुहोत्य् उपरिष्टाद् एके समामनन्ति ।
3.6.15.p.m: He offers an oblation before the fore-offerings with "Again with vigor..."; some prescribe [it] after.

3.6.15.q.m: He should characterize the clarified butter portion for Agni with [the word] "increasing" in the liturgical invocations.

3.6.15.s.s: saha rayyā \\ iti purastād anūyājānām āhutiṃ juhoty upariṣṭād eke samāmananti
3.6.15.s.d: सह रय्या \\ इति पुरस्ताद् अनूयाजानाम् आहुतिं जुहोत्य् उपरिष्टाद् एके समामनन्ति
3.6.15.s.m: He offers an oblation before the after-offerings with "Along with wealth..."; some prescribe [it] after.

3.6.15.t.s: devo agnau \ devo agnis \\ iti dvayor anūyājayor dve bibhaktī dadhāti /
3.6.15.t.d: देवो अग्नौ \ देवो अग्निस् \\ इति द्वयोर् अनूयाजयोर् द्वे बिभक्ती दधाति ।
3.6.15.t.m: "The god in Agni...", "The god is Agni..."—thus he introduces two grammatical case-inflections into two after-offerings.

3.6.15.u.m: He issues the ritual direction for the last after-offering loudly.

3.6.15.v.m: He should pour out as a subsequent offering a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni-Varuṇa.

3.6.15.w.s: yaḥ parācīnaṃ punarādheyād agnim ādadhīta sa etān homāñ juhuyāt \\ lekaḥ salekaḥ sulekaḥ \ ketaḥ saketaḥ suketas \\ vivasvām̐ aditir devajūtis \\ iti /
3.6.15.w.d: यः पराचीनं पुनराधेयाद् अग्निम् आदधीत स एतान् होमाञ् जुहुयात् \\ लेकः सलेकः सुलेकः \ केतः सकेतः सुकेतस् \\ विवस्वाम्̐ अदितिर् देवजूतिस् \\ इति ।
3.6.15.w.m: One who sets up the fires subsequent to the re-establishment of the fires should offer these oblations: "Leka, Saleka, Suleka / Keta, Saketa, Suketa / Vivasvat, Aditi, Devajūti."

3.6.15.x.s: [ ādhānaprabhṛti yāvajjīvaṃ gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnī dhāryete tathā sabhyāvasathyau dakṣiṇāgnes tv anugatasya manthanakalpo yadi mathitvādhīyate yady āhārya āharaṇam arthāyārthāyāhavanīyaṃ gārhapatyād uddharati nityaṃ gataśriyo dhāryata āyuṣkāmasya vā // ]
3.6.15.x.d: [ आधानप्रभृति यावज्जीवं गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्नी धार्येते तथा सभ्यावसथ्यौ दक्षिणाग्नेस् त्व् अनुगतस्य मन्थनकल्पो यदि मथित्वाधीयते यद्य् आहार्य आहरणम् अर्थायार्थायाहवनीयं गार्हपत्याद् उद्धरति नित्यं गतश्रियो धार्यत आयुष्कामस्य वा ॥ ]
3.6.15.x.m: [From the setting up of the fires onward, throughout life, the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fires are kept maintained, and likewise the sabhya and āvasathya fires. But if the dakṣiṇāgni has gone out, the rule is to churn it out if it is set up by churning; if it is to be brought, it is brought. For each separate purpose he takes out the āhavanīya fire from the gārhapatya; it is continuously maintained for one who has attained prosperity, or for one desiring long life.]

3.7.16.b.s: tasmai sāyaṃprātar jvalantaṃ gārhapatyād āhavanīyam uddharati /
3.7.16.b.d: तस्मै सायंप्रातर् ज्वलन्तं गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयम् उद्धरति ।
3.7.16.b.m: For it, evening and morning, he takes out the burning āhavanīya fire from the gārhapatya fire.

3.7.16.c.m: When the sun is atop the trees, [he takes it out] for the evening Agnihotra; at dawn for the morning Agnihotra.

3.7.16.e.s: uddhara \\ iti preṣite vācā tvā hotrā prāṇenodgātrā cakṣuṣādhvaryuṇā manasā brahmaṇā śrotreṇāgnīdhaitais tvā pañcabhir daivyair ṛtvigbhir uddharāmi \ jahāmi mṛtyum \ amṛtenādadhāmi \ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar \ uddhriyamāṇa uddhara pāpmano mā \ yad avidvān yac ca vidvām̐ś cakāra / \ ahnā yad enaḥ kṛtam asti pāpam \\ sarvasmān moddhṛto muñca tasmāt \\ iti sāyam /
3.7.16.e.d: उद्धर \\ इति प्रेषिते वाचा त्वा होत्रा प्राणेनोद्गात्रा चक्षुषाध्वर्युणा मनसा ब्रह्मणा श्रोत्रेणाग्नीधैतैस् त्वा पञ्चभिर् दैव्यैर् ऋत्विग्भिर् उद्धरामि \ जहामि मृत्युम् \ अमृतेनादधामि \ भूर् भुवः सुवर् \ उद्ध्रियमाण उद्धर पाप्मनो मा \ यद् अविद्वान् यच् च विद्वाम्̐श् चकार । \ अह्ना यद् एनः कृतम् अस्ति पापम् \\ सर्वस्मान् मोद्धृतो मुञ्च तस्मात् \\ इति सायम् ।
3.7.16.e.m: When directed, "Take out!", [he takes it out] with: "With speech as the hotṛ, with breath as the udgātṛ, with sight as the adhvaryu, with mind as the brahman, with hearing as the āgnīdhra—with these five divine priests I take you out. I abandon death, I establish with immortality. Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar! As you are being taken out, take me out from evil, whatever I have done unknowingly and knowingly. Whatever sin, whatever evil has been done by day, from all of that, being taken out, release me!"—thus in the evening.

3.7.16.f.s: rātryā yad enaḥ kṛtam asti pāpam \\ sarvasmān moddhṛto muñca tasmāt \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.16.f.d: रात्र्या यद् एनः कृतम् अस्ति पापम् \\ सर्वस्मान् मोद्धृतो मुञ्च तस्मात् \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.16.f.m: "Whatever sin, whatever evil has been done by night, from all of that, being taken out, release me!"—thus in the morning.

3.7.16.g.s: amṛtāhutim amṛtāyāṃ juhomi \\ agniṃ pṛthivyām amṛtasya jityai / \ tayānantaṃ kāmam ahaṃ jayāmi \ prajāpatir yaṃ prathamo jigāya \\ agnim agnau svāhā \\ iti sāyam āyatane pratiṣṭhāpayati /
3.7.16.g.d: अमृताहुतिम् अमृतायां जुहोमि \\ अग्निं पृथिव्याम् अमृतस्य जित्यै । \ तयानन्तं कामम् अहं जयामि \ प्रजापतिर् यं प्रथमो जिगाय \\ अग्निम् अग्नौ स्वाहा \\ इति सायम् आयतने प्रतिष्ठापयति ।
3.7.16.g.m: With: "I offer the immortal oblation in the immortal / fire upon the earth for the conquest of immortality; / by it I conquer boundless desire, / which Prajāpati first conquered. / To Agni in the fire, svāhā!"—thus in the evening he establishes it in its fireplace.

3.7.16.h.m: "To Sūrya in the fire, svāhā!"—thus in the morning.

3.7.16.i.s: prathamāstamite sāyamagnihotraṃ juhoti nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā pradoṣe voṣasi prātaragnihotraṃ purodayam udite vā yarhi vāk pravadet tarhi hotavyam ity ekeṣām /
3.7.16.i.d: प्रथमास्तमिते सायमग्निहोत्रं जुहोति नक्षत्रं दृष्ट्वा प्रदोषे वोषसि प्रातरग्निहोत्रं पुरोदयम् उदिते वा यर्हि वाक् प्रवदेत् तर्हि होतव्यम् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
3.7.16.i.m: Just when the sun has set, he offers the evening Agnihotra, or having seen a star, or at nightfall; at dawn [he offers] the morning Agnihotra, before sunrise or after the sun has risen; according to some, it should be offered when birds begin to chirp.

3.7.16.j.m: At this time all the ritual acts are performed, except the taking out [of the fire].

3.7.16.k.s: parisamūhanenāgnīn alaṃkaroti \\ agne gṛhapate śundhasva \\ iti gārhapatyam agne vahne śundhasva \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim agne samrāṭ śundhasva \\ ity āhavanīyam /
3.7.16.k.d: परिसमूहनेनाग्नीन् अलंकरोति \\ अग्ने गृहपते शुन्धस्व \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अग्ने वह्ने शुन्धस्व \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् अग्ने सम्राट् शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
3.7.16.k.m: He adorns the fires by sweeping around them: "O Agni, lord of the house, purify yourself!"—the gārhapatya; "O Agni, bearer [of oblations], purify yourself!"—the dakṣiṇāgni; "O Agni, sovereign, purify yourself!"—the āhavanīya.

3.7.16.l.s: purastād alaṃkārāḥ sāyam upariṣṭād alaṃkārāḥ prātaḥ /
3.7.16.l.d: पुरस्ताद् अलंकाराः सायम् उपरिष्टाद् अलंकाराः प्रातः ।
3.7.16.l.m: The adornments are performed beforehand in the evening, and afterwards in the morning.

3.7.16.m.m: Some teach the adornments on both sides.

3.7.16.n.s: agnihotrapātrāṇi prayunakti khādiram̐ sruvaṃ vaikaṅkatīm agnihotrahavaṇīm acakrāvartām aśūdrakṛtām ūrdhvakapālām agnihotrasthālīm /
3.7.16.n.d: अग्निहोत्रपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति खादिरम्̐ स्रुवं वैकङ्कतीम् अग्निहोत्रहवणीम् अचक्रावर्ताम् अशूद्रकृताम् ऊर्ध्वकपालाम् अग्निहोत्रस्थालीम् ।
3.7.16.n.m: He arranges the Agnihotra utensils: a sruva of khadira wood, an agnihotrahavaṇī of vikankaṭa wood, an agnihotrasthālī not made on a potter's wheel, not made by a Śūdra, and whose upper rim is elevated.

3.7.16.o.m: To the south of the sacrificial area the cow stands ready.

3.7.16.p.s: iḍa ehi \\ adita ehi \ sarasvaty ehi \ gaur ehi \\ iti tām āhūya pūṣāsi \\ iti vatsam upasṛjati dhāvantaṃ vānumantrayate /
3.7.16.p.d: इड एहि \\ अदित एहि \ सरस्वत्य् एहि \ गौर् एहि \\ इति ताम् आहूय पूषासि \\ इति वत्सम् उपसृजति धावन्तं वानुमन्त्रयते ।
3.7.16.p.m: Having called her with: "Come, Iḍā! Come, Aditi! Come, Sarasvatī! Come, cow!", he lets loose the calf [to her] with: "You are Pūṣan!", or follows it with a mantra as it runs.

3.7.16.q.s: prācīm udīcīṃ vāvṛtyānyaḥ śūdrād dogdhi na saṃmṛśati yathopalambham anūco vā /
3.7.16.q.d: प्राचीम् उदीचीं वावृत्यान्यः शूद्राद् दोग्धि न संमृशति यथोपलम्भम् अनूचो वा ।
3.7.16.q.m: Having turned her facing east or north, someone other than a Śūdra milks her, without touching [the milk], as it is received, or sitting straight.

3.7.16.r.s: pūrvau duhyāj jyeṣṭhasya jyaiṣṭhineyasya yo vā gataśrīḥ syād aparau duhyāt kaniṣṭhasya kāniṣṭhineyasya yo vā bubhūṣet /
3.7.16.r.d: पूर्वौ दुह्याज् ज्येष्ठस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयस्य यो वा गतश्रीः स्याद् अपरौ दुह्यात् कनिष्ठस्य कानिष्ठिनेयस्य यो वा बुभूषेत् ।
3.7.16.r.m: He should milk the two front teats for an eldest son, for the son of a senior wife, or for one who has attained prosperity; he should milk the two hind teats for a youngest son, for the son of a junior wife, or for one who desires to thrive.

3.7.16.s.s: dohane dugdhvā sthālyām ānayati sthālyāṃ vā dogdhi /
3.7.16.s.d: दोहने दुग्ध्वा स्थाल्याम् आनयति स्थाल्यां वा दोग्धि ।
3.7.16.s.m: Having milked into a milk pail, he pours it into the pot, or he milks directly into the pot.

3.7.16.t.s: dvayoḥ payasā paśukāmasya juhuyāt pūrvam adhiśrityottaram ānayet //
3.7.16.t.d: द्वयोः पयसा पशुकामस्य जुहुयात् पूर्वम् अधिश्रित्योत्तरम् आनयेत् ॥
3.7.16.t.m: For one desiring cattle, he should offer with the milk of two cows: having put the milk of the first on the fire, he should pour in that of the second.

3.7.17.a.s: ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmi \\ iti sāyaṃ pariṣiñcati satyaṃ tvartena pariṣiñcāmi \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.17.a.d: ऋतं त्वा सत्येन परिषिञ्चामि \\ इति सायं परिषिञ्चति सत्यं त्वर्तेन परिषिञ्चामि \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.17.a.m: With: "I sprinkle around you, the divine order, with truth," he sprinkles [water] around in the evening; with: "I sprinkle around you, truth, with the divine order," in the morning.

3.7.17.b.s: āhavanīyaṃ pariṣicya gārhapatyam atha dakṣiṇāgniṃ gārhapatyaṃ vā pariṣicya dakṣiṇāgnim athāhavanīyam /
3.7.17.b.d: आहवनीयं परिषिच्य गार्हपत्यम् अथ दक्षिणाग्निं गार्हपत्यं वा परिषिच्य दक्षिणाग्निम् अथाहवनीयम् ।
3.7.17.b.m: Having sprinkled around the āhavanīya, [he sprinkles] the gārhapatya, then the dakṣiṇāgni; or having sprinkled around the gārhapatya, [he sprinkles] the dakṣiṇāgni, then the āhavanīya.

3.7.17.c.s: yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai nayāmi \ saṃtatyai tvā yajñasya \\ iti gārhapatyāt saṃtatām apāṃ dhārām̐ srāvayaty āhavanīyāt /
3.7.17.c.d: यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै नयामि \ संतत्यै त्वा यज्ञस्य \\ इति गार्हपत्यात् संतताम् अपां धाराम्̐ स्रावयत्य् आहवनीयात् ।
3.7.17.c.m: With: "You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I lead you for the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice [I lead] you," he causes an unbroken stream of water to flow from the gārhapatya to the āhavanīya.

3.7.17.d.s: dhṛṣṭir asi \\ ity upaveṣam ādāya nirūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ saha tena yaṃ dviṣmaḥ subhūtāya śrayadhvam iti tena gārhapatyād udīco 'ṅgārān nirūhati /
3.7.17.d.d: धृष्टिर् असि \\ इत्य् उपवेषम् आदाय निरूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ सह तेन यं द्विष्मः सुभूताय श्रयध्वम् इति तेन गार्हपत्याद् उदीचो ऽङ्गारान् निरूहति ।
3.7.17.d.m: Taking the poker with: "You are the bold one," he draws out burning coals towards the north from the gārhapatya with: "Removed is the fear from strangers; together with that one whom we hate, take your support for prosperity!"

3.7.17.f.s: iḍāyāḥ padaṃ ghṛtavac carācaram \\ jātavedo havir idaṃ juṣasva / \ ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpās \ teṣām̐ saptānām iha rantir astu puṣṭis \\ iti teṣv agnihotram adhiśrayati /
3.7.17.f.d: इडायाः पदं घृतवच् चराचरम् \\ जातवेदो हविर् इदं जुषस्व । \ ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास् \ तेषाम्̐ सप्तानाम् इह रन्तिर् अस्तु पुष्टिस् \\ इति तेष्व् अग्निहोत्रम् अधिश्रयति ।
3.7.17.f.m: On them he places the Agnihotra milk to heat with: "The place of Iḍā, accompanied by ghee, moving and stationary— / O Jātavedas, enjoy this oblation! / Whatever domestic animals there are of all forms, / may delight and prosperity for those seven be here!"

3.7.17.h.s: anantaraṃ vādhiśrayaṇāt \\ udbhavaḥ stha \\ ud ahaṃ prajayā paśubhir bhūyāsam iti tṛṇaṃ pradīpyāvekṣate /
3.7.17.h.d: अनन्तरं वाधिश्रयणात् \\ उद्भवः स्थ \\ उद् अहं प्रजया पशुभिर् भूयासम् इति तृणं प्रदीप्यावेक्षते ।
3.7.17.h.m: Or immediately after placing it over [the fire], having lit a blade of grass, he inspects it with: "You are rising; may I rise with offspring and cattle!"

3.7.17.i.s: haras te mā vinaiṣam iti sruveṇādbhiḥ pratiṣiñcati \\ amṛtam asi \\ iti vā /
3.7.17.i.d: हरस् ते मा विनैषम् इति स्रुवेणाद्भिः प्रतिषिञ्चति \\ अमृतम् असि \\ इति वा ।
3.7.17.i.m: With: "May I not take away your heat," he sprinkles water over it with the sruva, or with: "You are immortal."

3.7.17.j.s: godohanasaṃnejanena pratiṣicyam ekena stokena pratiṣicyaṃ pratiṣiktaṃ paśukāmasya /
3.7.17.j.d: गोदोहनसंनेजनेन प्रतिषिच्यम् एकेन स्तोकेन प्रतिषिच्यं प्रतिषिक्तं पशुकामस्य ।
3.7.17.j.m: For one desiring cattle, it is to be sprinkled with the wash-water of the milk-pail, or sprinkled with a single drop, [or] sprinkled.

3.7.17.k.m: It is not sprinkled for one desiring fiery splendour, one practicing sorcery, or one desiring to overcome [difficulties].

3.7.17.l.s: yaḥ kāmayeta śūro me rāṣṭra ājāyeteti punar eva tasyāvekṣate yathā purastāt /
3.7.17.l.d: यः कामयेत शूरो मे राष्ट्र आजायेतेति पुनर् एव तस्यावेक्षते यथा पुरस्तात् ।
3.7.17.l.m: For one who desires, "May a hero be born in my realm," he inspects it again, just as before.

3.7.17.m.s: antaritam̐ rakṣas \\ ity ulmukena triḥ paryagni karoti pari vājapatis \\ iti vā /
3.7.17.m.d: अन्तरितम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् उल्मुकेन त्रिः पर्यग्नि करोति परि वाजपतिस् \\ इति वा ।
3.7.17.m.m: With a firebrand he carries fire around it three times with: "Warded off is the rakṣas!", or with: "Around the lord of prizes..."

3.7.17.n.s: prajāṃ me yaccha \\ ity ante dhārayati /
3.7.17.n.d: प्रजां मे यच्छ \\ इत्य् अन्ते धारयति ।
3.7.17.n.m: He holds it at the end with: "Bestow offspring upon me!"

3.7.17.o.s: pratyūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ saha tena yaṃ dviṣmaḥ subhūtam akarta \\ iti tena gārhapatye 'ṅgārān pratyūhati bhūtakṛtaḥ sthāpya \\ iti sasyaṃ yajamānasya \\ iti vā /
3.7.17.o.d: प्रत्यूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ सह तेन यं द्विष्मः सुभूतम् अकर्त \\ इति तेन गार्हपत्ये ऽङ्गारान् प्रत्यूहति भूतकृतः स्थाप्य \\ इति सस्यं यजमानस्य \\ इति वा ।
3.7.17.o.m: With that [poker] he pushes back the coals into the gārhapatya with: "Repelled is the fear from strangers; together with that one whom we hate, you have made it well-being," or with: "Having established the makers of being, [grant] crops to the sacrificer!"

3.7.17.p.s: devasya tvā \\ iti sruvam agnihotrahavaṇīṃ cādāya /
3.7.17.p.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति स्रुवम् अग्निहोत्रहवणीं चादाय ।
3.7.17.p.m: Having taken the sruva and the agnihotrahavaṇī with: "At the impulse of the god..."

3.7.17.q.s: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
3.7.17.q.d: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति ।
3.7.17.q.m: he heats them over the fire in the āhavanīya or the gārhapatya with: "Scorched [are the demons]..."

3.7.17.r.s: suparṇāṃ tvā suparṇamayīm \\ hiraṇyayaṣṭir asy amṛtapālāśāḥ sroto yajñānām ity agnihotrahavaṇīm̐ saṃmārṣṭi /
3.7.17.r.d: सुपर्णां त्वा सुपर्णमयीम् \\ हिरण्ययष्टिर् अस्य् अमृतपालाशाः स्रोतो यज्ञानाम् इत्य् अग्निहोत्रहवणीम्̐ संमार्ष्टि ।
3.7.17.r.m: He wipes the agnihotrahavaṇī with: "You, well-winged, consisting of fair wings, a golden shaft you are, with leaves of palāśa for immortality, the stream of sacrifices."

3.7.17.s.s: ariṣṭo yajamānaḥ patnī ca \\ ity ubhayam /
3.7.17.s.d: अरिष्टो यजमानः पत्नी च \\ इत्य् उभयम् ।
3.7.17.s.m: [He wipes] both with: "May the sacrificer and his wife be unharmed."

3.7.17.t.s: om unneṣyāmi havyaṃ devebhyaḥ pāpmano yajamānam iti sāyam āmantrayate /
3.7.17.t.d: ओम् उन्नेष्यामि हव्यं देवेभ्यः पाप्मनो यजमानम् इति सायम् आमन्त्रयते ।
3.7.17.t.m: In the evening he addresses [the sacrificer]: "Om! I shall ladle up the oblation for the gods, [and] the sacrificer from evil."

3.7.17.u.s: om unnayāmi havyaṃ devebhyaḥ pāpmano yajamānam iti prātaḥ /
3.7.17.u.d: ओम् उन्नयामि हव्यं देवेभ्यः पाप्मनो यजमानम् इति प्रातः ।
3.7.17.u.m: In the morning [he addresses him]: "Om! I ladle up the oblation for the gods, [and] the sacrificer from evil."

3.7.17.v.s: pravasati \\ om unnaya \\ iti svayam ātmānaṃ praty eva brūyāt /
3.7.17.v.d: प्रवसति \\ ओम् उन्नय \\ इति स्वयम् आत्मानं प्रत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
3.7.17.v.m: If [the sacrificer] is on a journey, he should say to himself alone: "Om! Ladle up!"

3.7.17.w.s: agnaye ca tvā pṛthivyai connayāmi \ vātāya ca tvāntarikṣāya connayāmi \ sūryāya ca tvā dive connayāmi \\ adbhyaś ca tvauṣadhībhyaś connayāmi \\ iti caturaḥ sruvān unnayaty uttamena dviḥ pañcāvattinaḥ /
3.7.17.w.d: अग्नये च त्वा पृथिव्यै चोन्नयामि \ वाताय च त्वान्तरिक्षाय चोन्नयामि \ सूर्याय च त्वा दिवे चोन्नयामि \\ अद्भ्यश् च त्वौषधीभ्यश् चोन्नयामि \\ इति चतुरः स्रुवान् उन्नयत्य् उत्तमेन द्विः पञ्चावत्तिनः ।
3.7.17.w.m: With: "I ladle you up for Agni and the earth; I ladle you up for Vāta and the intermediate space; I ladle you up for Sūrya and the sky; I ladle you up for the waters and the plants," he ladles out four sruva-spoonfuls; for one who takes five portions, twice with the last [mantra].

3.7.17.x.s: bhūr iḍā \ bhuva iḍā \ suvar iḍā \ karad iḍā \\ iti vā jvalad iḍā \\ iti pañcavattinaḥ /
3.7.17.x.d: भूर् इडा \ भुव इडा \ सुवर् इडा \ करद् इडा \\ इति वा ज्वलद् इडा \\ इति पञ्चवत्तिनः ।
3.7.17.x.m: Or with: "Bhūr iḍā! Bhuva iḍā! Suvar iḍā! Karad iḍā!", or for one who takes five portions: "Jvalad iḍā!"

3.7.17.y.s: yaṃ prati putrāṇāṃ kāmayetānenardhnuyām iti taṃ prati pūrṇam unnayet /
3.7.17.y.d: यं प्रति पुत्राणां कामयेतानेनर्ध्नुयाम् इति तं प्रति पूर्णम् उन्नयेत् ।
3.7.17.y.m: In regard to whichever of his sons he desires, "May I prosper through him," in his direction he should ladle it out full.

3.7.17.z.s: yadi kāmayeta sarve sadṛśāḥ syur iti sarvān samaśa unnayet /
3.7.17.z.d: यदि कामयेत सर्वे सदृशाः स्युर् इति सर्वान् समश उन्नयेत् ।
3.7.17.z.m: If he should desire that all [his sons] should be equal, he should ladle out equally for all.

3.7.17.aa.m: He touches the ladled-out [portion] with the Daśahotṛ formula, or he does not touch it.

3.7.17.ab.s: sajūr devaiḥ sāyaṃyāvabhiḥ \ sāyaṃyāvāno mā devāḥ svasti saṃpādayantu paśubhiḥ saṃpṛcīya \\ iti sāyam unnītam̐ sthālīṃ cābhimṛśati sajūr devaiḥ prātaryāvabhiḥ \ prātaryāvāṇo mā devāḥ svasti saṃpādayantu paśubhiḥ saṃpṛcīya \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.17.ab.d: सजूर् देवैः सायंयावभिः \ सायंयावानो मा देवाः स्वस्ति संपादयन्तु पशुभिः संपृचीय \\ इति सायम् उन्नीतम्̐ स्थालीं चाभिमृशति सजूर् देवैः प्रातर्यावभिः \ प्रातर्यावाणो मा देवाः स्वस्ति संपादयन्तु पशुभिः संपृचीय \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.17.ab.m: In the evening, he touches the ladled-out [portion] and the pot with: 'In union with the gods who go in the evening; / may the gods who go in the evening produce well-being for me; may I be united with cattle!' [and] in the morning with: 'In union with the gods who go in the morning; / may the gods who go in the morning produce well-being for me; may I be united with cattle!'

3.7.17.ac.s: prācīm udīcīṃ vāhṛtyāpareṇa gārhapatyam upasādayatīty ekeṣām //
3.7.17.ac.d: प्राचीम् उदीचीं वाहृत्यापरेण गार्हपत्यम् उपसादयतीत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
3.7.17.ac.m: According to some teachers, having brought it eastwards or northwards, he sets it down to the west of the gārhapatya fire.

3.7.18.a.s: pālāśīm̐ samidhaṃ prādeśamātrīm ekāṃ dve tisro vopariṣṭāt srugdaṇḍa upasaṃgṛhya /
3.7.18.a.d: पालाशीम्̐ समिधं प्रादेशमात्रीम् एकां द्वे तिस्रो वोपरिष्टात् स्रुग्दण्ड उपसंगृह्य ।
3.7.18.a.m: Having grasped from above upon the handle of the ladle one, two, or three firewood sticks of palāśa wood, a span in length,

3.7.18.b.s: urv antarikṣaṃ vīhi \\ iti samayā gārhapatyasyārcir harati /
3.7.18.b.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षं वीहि \\ इति समया गार्हपत्यस्यार्चिर् हरति ।
3.7.18.b.m: with 'Traverse the wide intermediate space!' he carries [the ladle] straight through the flame of the gārhapatya fire.

3.7.18.c.m: Running forward towards the east, he recites the Daśahotṛ formula.

3.7.18.d.s: agnaye tvā vaiśvānarāya \\ iti madhyadeśe nigṛhṇāti /
3.7.18.d.d: अग्नये त्वा वैश्वानराय \\ इति मध्यदेशे निगृह्णाति ।
3.7.18.d.m: With 'For Agni Vaiśvānara thee!' he lowers [the ladle] in the middle space.

3.7.18.e.m: With 'For Vāta thee!' he raises it.

3.7.18.f.s: āyur me yaccha \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyam oṣadhīṣūpasādayati /
3.7.18.f.d: आयुर् मे यच्छ \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयम् ओषधीषूपसादयति ।
3.7.18.f.m: With 'Grant me long life!' he sets it down upon the herbs to the west of the āhavanīya fire.

3.7.18.g.s: eṣā te agne samit \\ iti samidham ādadhāti /
3.7.18.g.d: एषा ते अग्ने समित् \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति ।
3.7.18.g.m: With 'This is thy firewood stick, O Agni!' he places the firewood stick [on the fire].

3.7.18.h.s: hiraṇyayaṃ tvā vam̐śam̐ svargasya lokasya saṃkramaṇaṃ dadhāmi \\ iti vā tā asya sūdadohasas \\ iti vā rajatāṃ tvā haritagarbhām agnir jyotiṣā jyotiṣmatīm̐ svargyāṃ kāmadughām akṣitām akṣityā āptyai vyāptyai samāptyai kāmāya svargāya lokāyāmṛtatvāya rātrim iṣṭakām upadadhe \\ iti sāyam \\ hariṇīṃ tvā rajatagarbhām̐ sūryo jyotiṣā jyotiṣmatīm̐ svargyāṃ kāmadughām akṣitām akṣityā āptyai vyāptyai samāptyai kāmāya svargāya lokāyāmṛtatvāyāhar iṣṭakām upadadhe \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.18.h.d: हिरण्ययं त्वा वम्̐शम्̐ स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य संक्रमणं दधामि \\ इति वा ता अस्य सूददोहसस् \\ इति वा रजतां त्वा हरितगर्भाम् अग्निर् ज्योतिषा ज्योतिष्मतीम्̐ स्वर्ग्यां कामदुघाम् अक्षिताम् अक्षित्या आप्त्यै व्याप्त्यै समाप्त्यै कामाय स्वर्गाय लोकायामृतत्वाय रात्रिम् इष्टकाम् उपदधे \\ इति सायम् \\ हरिणीं त्वा रजतगर्भाम्̐ सूर्यो ज्योतिषा ज्योतिष्मतीम्̐ स्वर्ग्यां कामदुघाम् अक्षिताम् अक्षित्या आप्त्यै व्याप्त्यै समाप्त्यै कामाय स्वर्गाय लोकायामृतत्वायाहर् इष्टकाम् उपदधे \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.18.h.m: Or with 'I place thee, golden beam, as the bridge to the heavenly world!' or with 'They, his well-milked streams...'; in the evening with: 'Thee, silver-colored, containing gold within, luminous through Agni with light, leading to heaven, yielding desires, imperishable, for imperishableness, for attainment, for pervasive attainment, for completion, for desire, for the heavenly world, for immortality, do I lay down, the brick of Night!' and in the morning with: 'Thee, golden, containing silver within, luminous through Sūrya with light, leading to heaven, yielding desires, imperishable, for imperishableness, for attainment, for pervasive attainment, for completion, for desire, for the heavenly world, for immortality, do I lay down, the brick of Day!'

3.7.18.i.s: vidyud asi \ vidya me pāpmānam \ ṛtam̐ satyam upaimi \ mayi śraddhā \\ ity apa upaspṛśya /
3.7.18.i.d: विद्युद् असि \ विद्य मे पाप्मानम् \ ऋतम्̐ सत्यम् उपैमि \ मयि श्रद्धा \\ इत्य् अप उपस्पृश्य ।
3.7.18.i.m: Having touched water with: 'Thou art lightning; divide my evil; I approach the cosmic order, the truth; in me is faith!'

3.7.18.j.m: When it has become somewhat dusky, then he offers while it is flaming.

3.7.18.k.m: Or when, its flame having subsided, it flickers, as it were.

3.7.18.l.m: For one who desires a village, [he offers] when it is smoking.

3.7.18.m.m: Letting [the oblation] flow along the firewood stick two angulas from the base,

3.7.18.n.s: hotrā bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar \ agnir jyotir jyotir agniḥ svāhā \\ iti sāyam̐ hotrā bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar \\ sūryo jyotir jyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.18.n.d: होत्रा भूर् भुवः सुवर् \ अग्निर् ज्योतिर् ज्योतिर् अग्निः स्वाहा \\ इति सायम्̐ होत्रा भूर् भुवः सुवर् \\ सूर्यो ज्योतिर् ज्योतिः सूर्यः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.18.n.m: [he offers] in the evening with: 'Through the hotṛ-office! Bhūḥ! Bhuvaḥ! Suvaḥ! Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā!' and in the morning with: 'Through the hotṛ-office! Bhūḥ! Bhuvaḥ! Suvaḥ! Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā!'

3.7.18.o.m: Some hand down a mingled offering:

3.7.18.p.s: agnir jyotir jyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā \\ iti sāyaṃ sūryo jyotir jyotir agniḥ svāhā \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.18.p.d: अग्निर् ज्योतिर् ज्योतिः सूर्यः स्वाहा \\ इति सायं सूर्यो ज्योतिर् ज्योतिर् अग्निः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.18.p.m: in the evening with: 'Agni is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā!' and in the morning with: 'Sūrya is light, light is Agni, svāhā!'

3.7.18.q.s: varco me yaccha \\ iti punar oṣadhīṣūpasādayati /
3.7.18.q.d: वर्चो मे यच्छ \\ इति पुनर् ओषधीषूपसादयति ।
3.7.18.q.m: With 'Grant me splendor!' he sets [the ladle] down again upon the herbs.

3.7.18.r.s: lepam ādāya \\ oṣadhībhyas tvā \\ oṣadhīr jinva \\ ity uttarato barhiṣi lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
3.7.18.r.d: लेपम् आदाय \\ ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा \\ ओषधीर् जिन्व \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो बर्हिषि लेपं निमार्ष्टि ।
3.7.18.r.m: Taking the residue, he wipes off the residue on the sacred grass to the north with: 'Thee for the plants!' [and] 'Quicken the plants!'

3.7.18.s.s: agne gṛhapate mā mā saṃtāpsīs \\ ātmann amṛtam adhiṣi \ prajā jyotir aśīya \\ iti gārhapatyam avekṣate /
3.7.18.s.d: अग्ने गृहपते मा मा संताप्सीस् \\ आत्मन्न् अमृतम् अधिषि \ प्रजा ज्योतिर् अशीय \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अवेक्षते ।
3.7.18.s.m: He looks at the gārhapatya fire with: 'O Agni, lord of the house, do not burn me! May I place immortality in myself; may I obtain offspring and light!'

3.7.18.t.s: atihāya tūṣṇīm uttarām̐ samidhi bhūyasīṃ juhoti /
3.7.18.t.d: अतिहाय तूष्णीम् उत्तराम्̐ समिधि भूयसीं जुहोति ।
3.7.18.t.m: Stepping past [the previous spot], he silently offers the second, larger [offering] on the firewood stick.

3.7.18.u.s: sajūr jātavedo diva ā pṛthivyā juṣāṇo asya haviṣo ghṛtasya vīhi svāhā \\ ity ājyena juhuyād yatra paśupatiḥ paśūñ chāmayet /
3.7.18.u.d: सजूर् जातवेदो दिव आ पृथिव्या जुषाणो अस्य हविषो घृतस्य वीहि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आज्येन जुहुयाद् यत्र पशुपतिः पशूञ् छामयेत् ।
3.7.18.u.m: Where Paśupati destroys cattle, he should offer clarified butter with: 'In union, O Jātavedas, from heaven and from earth, enjoying this oblation of clarified butter, partake, svāhā!'

3.7.18.v.s: agne duḥśīrtatano juṣasva svāhā \\ iti juhuyād yadi tad atihanyāt /
3.7.18.v.d: अग्ने दुःशीर्ततनो जुषस्व स्वाहा \\ इति जुहुयाद् यदि तद् अतिहन्यात् ।
3.7.18.v.m: If it should strike [the cattle] excessively, he should offer with: 'O Agni of broken body, enjoy, svāhā!'

3.7.18.w.s: dvādaśa rātrīḥ sāyam̐sāyaṃ juhuyād yadi tad atihanyāt /
3.7.18.w.d: द्वादश रात्रीः सायम्̐सायं जुहुयाद् यदि तद् अतिहन्यात् ।
3.7.18.w.m: He should offer every evening for twelve nights if it should strike [them] excessively.

3.7.18.y.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti sāyaṃ lepam avamārṣṭi /
3.7.18.y.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति सायं लेपम् अवमार्ष्टि ।
3.7.18.y.m: In the evening, he wipes downward the residue with: 'Thee for food!'

3.7.18.z.m: In the morning, he wipes upward with: 'Thee for strength!'

3.7.18.aa.s: yaṃ kāmayetāvatarāṃ pāpīyān syād iti bhūyas tasya pūrvam̐ hutvottaraṃ kanīyo juhuyāt /
3.7.18.aa.d: यं कामयेतावतरां पापीयान् स्याद् इति भूयस् तस्य पूर्वम्̐ हुत्वोत्तरं कनीयो जुहुयात् ।
3.7.18.aa.m: For one whom he would desire to be progressively worse off, having offered more in his first [offering], he should offer less in his second.

3.7.18.ab.s: yaṃ kāmayeta na pāpīyān na śreyān syād iti samaṃ tasya juhuyāt /
3.7.18.ab.d: यं कामयेत न पापीयान् न श्रेयान् स्याद् इति समं तस्य जुहुयात् ।
3.7.18.ab.m: For one whom he would desire to be neither worse off nor better off, he should offer equally for him.

3.7.18.ac.s: yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyān syād iti kanīyas tasya pūrvam̐ hutvottaraṃ bhūyo juhuyāt /
3.7.18.ac.d: यं कामयेत वसीयान् स्याद् इति कनीयस् तस्य पूर्वम्̐ हुत्वोत्तरं भूयो जुहुयात् ।
3.7.18.ac.m: For one whom he would desire to be wealthier, having offered less in his first [offering], he should offer more in his second.

3.7.18.ad.m: He leaves behind more for the consumption.

3.7.18.ae.m: Having offered, he should look around broadly.

3.7.18.af.s: rudra mṛḍa \\ anārbhava mṛḍa \ dhūrta mṛḍa \ namas te astu paśupate mā mā him̐sīs \\ iti srucā trir udañcam agnim ativalgayati /
3.7.18.af.d: रुद्र मृड \\ अनार्भव मृड \ धूर्त मृड \ नमस् ते अस्तु पशुपते मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति स्रुचा त्रिर् उदञ्चम् अग्निम् अतिवल्गयति ।
3.7.18.af.m: With the offering ladle, he causes the fire to leap three times northward with: 'O Rudra, be gracious! O non-Ṛbhu, be gracious! O mischievous one, be gracious! Homage be to thee, O Paśupati; do not injure me!'

3.7.18.ag.m: Having set down the offering ladle and taken the residue,

3.7.18.ai.s: pūṣāsi \\ iti dvir aṅgulyā prāśyācamya punaḥ prāśnāti /
3.7.18.ai.d: पूषासि \\ इति द्विर् अङ्गुल्या प्राश्याचम्य पुनः प्राश्नाति ।
3.7.18.ai.m: having consumed twice with his finger with 'Thou art Pūṣan!' and having sipped water, he consumes again.

3.7.18.aj.m: Having taken the offering ladle and darbha blades, having glided northwards,

3.7.18.ak.s: āgneyam̐ retaḥ prajananaṃ me astu \ daśavīram̐ sarvagaṇam̐ svastaye / \ ātmasani prajāsani paśusani \\ abhayasani lokasani vṛṣṭisani / \ agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotu \\ annaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta / \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat \\ iti //
3.7.18.ak.d: आग्नेयम्̐ रेतः प्रजननं मे अस्तु \ दशवीरम्̐ सर्वगणम्̐ स्वस्तये । \ आत्मसनि प्रजासनि पशुसनि \\ अभयसनि लोकसनि वृष्टिसनि । \ अग्निः प्रजां बहुलां मे करोतु \\ अन्नं पयो रेतो अस्मासु धत्त । \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् \\ इति ॥
3.7.18.ak.m: [he recites:] 'May the fiery seed of Agni be procreation for me, / with ten heroes, with a whole troop, for well-being! / Winner of self, winner of offspring, winner of cattle, / winner of fearlessness, winner of the world, winner of rain! / May Agni make my offspring abundant; / place food, milk, seed in us! / May he uphold abundance of wealth, food, and strength in us!'

3.7.19.a.s: prāgdaṇḍayodagdaṇḍayā vā srucā dvir ācāmati dviś ca nirleḍhi /
3.7.19.a.d: प्राग्दण्डयोदग्दण्डया वा स्रुचा द्विर् आचामति द्विश् च निर्लेढि ।
3.7.19.a.m: With the offering ladle whose handle is turned eastwards or northwards, he sips twice and licks twice.

3.7.19.b.s: garbhebhyas tvā \ garbhān prīṇīhi \\ iti vā /
3.7.19.b.d: गर्भेभ्यस् त्वा \ गर्भान् प्रीणीहि \\ इति वा ।
3.7.19.b.m: Or with: 'Thee for the embryos!' [and] 'Gratify the embryos!'

3.7.19.c.s: sauryam̐ retaḥ prajananaṃ me astu \\ iti prātaḥ /
3.7.19.c.d: सौर्यम्̐ रेतः प्रजननं मे अस्तु \\ इति प्रातः ।
3.7.19.c.m: In the morning, [he recites:] 'May the solar seed be procreation for me!'

3.7.19.d.s: srucam adbhiḥ pūrayitvā sarpebhyas tvā \ sarpāñ jinva \\ iti vidhukṣati /
3.7.19.d.d: स्रुचम् अद्भिः पूरयित्वा सर्पेभ्यस् त्वा \ सर्पाञ् जिन्व \\ इति विधुक्षति ।
3.7.19.d.m: Having filled the offering ladle with water, he shakes it out with: 'Thee for the serpents!' [and] 'Quicken the serpents!'

3.7.19.f.m: having washed the offering ladle with darbha blades,

3.7.19.g.s: pūrayitvā sarpān pipīlikāñ jinva \\ ity apa utsiñcati /
3.7.19.g.d: पूरयित्वा सर्पान् पिपीलिकाञ् जिन्व \\ इत्य् अप उत्सिञ्चति ।
3.7.19.g.m: having filled it, he pours out water with: 'Quicken the serpents and the ants!'

3.7.19.h.s: sarpadevajanāñ jinva \\ iti dvitīyāṃ bhūtebhyas tvā \\ iti tṛtīyāṃ mahate devāya \\ iti caturthīm /
3.7.19.h.d: सर्पदेवजनाञ् जिन्व \\ इति द्वितीयां भूतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति तृतीयां महते देवाय \\ इति चतुर्थीम् ।
3.7.19.h.m: [He pours out] a second [portion of water] with 'Quicken the divine folk of the serpents!', a third with 'Thee for the beings!', [and] a fourth with 'For the great god!'

3.7.19.i.s: srucam adbhiḥ pūrayitvā pṛthivyām amṛtaṃ juhomi svāhā \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyaṃ ninayati /
3.7.19.i.d: स्रुचम् अद्भिः पूरयित्वा पृथिव्याम् अमृतं जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यं निनयति ।
3.7.19.i.m: Having filled the offering ladle with water, he pours it out behind the āhavanīya fire or behind the gārhapatya fire with: 'I offer immortality upon the earth, svāhā!'

3.7.19.j.s: gṛhebhyas tvā \ gṛhān prīṇīhi \\ iti tasyaikadeśam añjalau patnyaḥ /
3.7.19.j.d: गृहेभ्यस् त्वा \ गृहान् प्रीणीहि \\ इति तस्यैकदेशम् अञ्जलौ पत्न्यः ।
3.7.19.j.m: With 'Thee for the houses!' [and] 'Gratify the houses!' [he pours] a portion of it into the folded hands of the sacrificer's wife.

3.7.19.k.m: If the sacrificer's wife is not sitting nearby, [he pours] all of it upon the earth.

3.7.19.l.s: hastaṃ pratāpya srucy avadadhāti srucaṃ vā niṣṭapya haste 'vadadhāti saptarṣibhyas tvā \ saptarṣīñ jinva \\ iti srucodag uddiśati /
3.7.19.l.d: हस्तं प्रताप्य स्रुच्य् अवदधाति स्रुचं वा निष्टप्य हस्ते ऽवदधाति सप्तर्षिभ्यस् त्वा \ सप्तर्षीञ् जिन्व \\ इति स्रुचोदग् उद्दिशति ।
3.7.19.l.m: Having heated his hand, he places it on the offering ladle, or having heated the offering ladle, he places it on his hand, and points northward with the offering ladle with: 'Thee for the Seven Ṛṣis!' [and] 'Quicken the Seven Ṛṣis!'

3.7.19.m.s: srucaṃ nidhāya pratyetya sruveṇa gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyor juhoti pratyāhuti samidho 'bhyādhāya /
3.7.19.m.d: स्रुचं निधाय प्रत्येत्य स्रुवेण गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्योर् जुहोति प्रत्याहुति समिधो ऽभ्याधाय ।
3.7.19.m.m: Having put down the offering ladle, having returned, he offers with the dipping ladle into the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fires, having put on a firewood stick for each oblation.

3.7.19.n.s: mayi puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātu \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat / \ agnaye gṛhapataye rayipataye paśupataye puṣṭipataye kāmāyānnādyāya svāhā \\ iti dve gārhapatye juhoti /
3.7.19.n.d: मयि पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधातु \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् । \ अग्नये गृहपतये रयिपतये पशुपतये पुष्टिपतये कामायान्नाद्याय स्वाहा \\ इति द्वे गार्हपत्ये जुहोति ।
3.7.19.n.m: He offers two oblations in the gārhapatya fire with: 'May the lord of nourishment place nourishment in me! / May he uphold abundance of wealth, food, and strength in us! / For Agni, the lord of the house, lord of wealth, lord of cattle, lord of nourishment, for desire, for the eating of food, svāhā!'

3.7.19.o.s: annapate 'nnasya no dehi \\ iti dve dakṣiṇāgnau /
3.7.19.o.d: अन्नपते ऽन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति द्वे दक्षिणाग्नौ ।
3.7.19.o.m: [He offers] two in the dakṣiṇāgni fire with: 'O lord of food, give us of food!'

3.7.19.p.s: api vā catasro gārhapatye juhuyāc catasro dakṣiṇāgnau /
3.7.19.p.d: अपि वा चतस्रो गार्हपत्ये जुहुयाच् चतस्रो दक्षिणाग्नौ ।
3.7.19.p.m: Or he may offer four in the gārhapatya fire and four in the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

3.7.19.r.s: piprer agniḥ svāṃ tanuvam \ ayāḍ dyāvāpṛthivī \ ūrjam asmāsu dhehi iti sthālyāṃ tṛṇam aṅktvāhavanīye 'nupraharati na vā /
3.7.19.r.d: पिप्रेर् अग्निः स्वां तनुवम् \ अयाड् द्यावापृथिवी \ ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धेहि इति स्थाल्यां तृणम् अङ्क्त्वाहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति न वा ।
3.7.19.r.m: Having anointed a blade of grass in the pot with: 'Agni has pleased his own body; he has sacrificed to Heaven and Earth; place strength in us!', he throws it into the āhavanīya fire, or he does not.

3.7.19.s.s: dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā \ dyāvāpṛthivī jinva \\ ity antarvedyām̐ saṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati /
3.7.19.s.d: द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा \ द्यावापृथिवी जिन्व \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्याम्̐ संक्षालनं निनयति ।
3.7.19.s.m: With the mantra: 'For Heaven and Earth thee; gratify Heaven and Earth,' he pours the wash-water inside the altar.

3.7.19.t.m: He sprinkles water around as before.

3.7.19.u.m: With the mantras, 'Shine forth,' 'May I shine,' 'You shine,' he fuels [the fire].

3.7.19.v.s: ājyena juhuyāt tejaskāmasya payasā paśukāmasya dadhnendriyakāmasya taṇḍulair ojaskāmasya yavāgvā grāmakāmasyaudanenānnādyakāmasya mām̐sena vīryakāmasya somena brahmavarcasakāmasya /
3.7.19.v.d: आज्येन जुहुयात् तेजस्कामस्य पयसा पशुकामस्य दध्नेन्द्रियकामस्य तण्डुलैर् ओजस्कामस्य यवाग्वा ग्रामकामस्यौदनेनान्नाद्यकामस्य माम्̐सेन वीर्यकामस्य सोमेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य ।
3.7.19.v.m: He should offer with clarified butter for one desiring splendor, with milk for one desiring cattle, with curd for one desiring sensory power, with husked grains for one desiring vigor, with barley gruel for one desiring a village, with boiled rice for one desiring food and nourishment, with meat for one desiring valor, [and] with soma for one desiring spiritual luster.

3.7.19.w.s: yad anyad adhiśrayaṇāt pratiṣecanāc ca tad dadhnas taṇḍulānām̐ somasya ca kriyate /
3.7.19.w.d: यद् अन्यद् अधिश्रयणात् प्रतिषेचनाच् च तद् दध्नस् तण्डुलानाम्̐ सोमस्य च क्रियते ।
3.7.19.w.m: Whatever [rule applies to the ritual] other than placing upon the fire and pouring water around is performed for curd, for husked grains, and for soma.

3.7.19.x.s: apāṃ pratyasanakāle darbhatṛṇābhyām ājyaṃ pratyasyet pratiṣekaṃ yavāgūm̐ śrapayati / yathā yavāgūm evaṃ mām̐sam /
3.7.19.x.d: अपां प्रत्यसनकाले दर्भतृणाभ्याम् आज्यं प्रत्यस्येत् प्रतिषेकं यवागूम्̐ श्रपयति । यथा यवागूम् एवं माम्̐सम् ।
3.7.19.x.m: At the time of throwing in water, he should throw in clarified butter with two blades of darbha grass; he cooks the barley gruel [by] pouring [water around]. Meat is prepared in the same manner as barley gruel.

3.7.19.y.m: For a kṣatriya, he should offer the Agnihotra on the transition days (parvan), not in the interval.

3.7.19.z.s: yat tv asya gṛhe 'nnaṃ kriyate tasmād brāhmaṇāya mukhato haranti tad dhutam asyāgnihotraṃ bhavati ya ṛtam̐ satyam iva vadann ījānaḥ somena syāt tasya sadāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt //
3.7.19.z.d: यत् त्व् अस्य गृहे ऽन्नं क्रियते तस्माद् ब्राह्मणाय मुखतो हरन्ति तद् धुतम् अस्याग्निहोत्रं भवति य ऋतम्̐ सत्यम् इव वदन्न् ईजानः सोमेन स्यात् तस्य सदाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् ॥
3.7.19.z.m: However, whatever food is prepared in his house, from that they take first of all for a brāhmaṇa: that becomes his offered Agnihotra. If one who has sacrificed with soma should be speaking the truth as if it were cosmic order, for him he should offer the Agnihotra constantly.

3.8.20.a.m: We shall explain the journey away from home without the household [fires].

3.8.20.b.s: sagṛhastu prayāsyan yatra pañca nava daśa vā sam̐hitā vasati yatra vā navarātraṃ vāstu punar abhyety ekāṃ vasati tatra vāstoṣpatīyaṃ juhoti /
3.8.20.b.d: सगृहस्तु प्रयास्यन् यत्र पञ्च नव दश वा सम्̐हिता वसति यत्र वा नवरात्रं वास्तु पुनर् अभ्येत्य् एकां वसति तत्र वास्तोष्पतीयं जुहोति ।
3.8.20.b.m: When, however, intending to set out with his household, he stays where five, nine, or ten [days] have passed together, or where he returns to a dwelling place for nine nights and stays for one night, there he offers the Vāstoṣpatīya offering.

3.8.20.c.m: He places all the household utensils onto the conveyances.

3.8.20.d.s: yad anyaj jihīrṣanti pūrvaṃ tat pravahanti /
3.8.20.d.d: यद् अन्यज् जिहीर्षन्ति पूर्वं तत् प्रवहन्ति ।
3.8.20.d.m: Whatever else they wish to transport, they convey that forward first.

3.8.20.e.m: Or before the offering is made, they remove [it] from that place.

3.8.20.f.s: sarveṣu yukteṣu dakṣiṇo 'gniṣṭhasya yukto bhavati savyasya yoktraṃ parihṛtam anūtsaktam atha vāstoṣpatīyam anudruyottarayā juhoti /
3.8.20.f.d: सर्वेषु युक्तेषु दक्षिणो ऽग्निष्ठस्य युक्तो भवति सव्यस्य योक्त्रं परिहृतम् अनूत्सक्तम् अथ वास्तोष्पतीयम् अनुद्रुयोत्तरया जुहोति ।
3.8.20.f.m: When all [draught-animals] are yoked, the right [animal] of the pole-cart is yoked, the yoking-strap of the left [animal] is passed around and hooked on, then having recited the Vāstoṣpatīya hymn, he offers with the following [verse].

3.8.20.h.m: He does not depart without extinguishing the embers.

3.8.20.i.s: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ iti pṛthagaraṇīṣv agnīn samāropya prayāti /
3.8.20.i.d: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इति पृथगरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोप्य प्रयाति ।
3.8.20.i.m: With the mantra, 'This is your seasonal womb,' having caused the fires to mount into the kindling sticks separately, he departs.

3.8.20.j.s: atho khalv āhur yad araṇyoḥ samārūḍho naśyed ud asyāgniḥ sīdet punarādheyaḥ syād iti yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayehi \\ ārohātmātmānam \ acchā vasūni kṛṇvann asme naryā purūṇi / \ yajño bhūtvā yajñam āsīda svāṃ yoniṃ jātavedo bhuva ājāyamānaḥ sakṣaya ehi \\ ity ātman samāropya prayāti /
3.8.20.j.d: अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् अरण्योः समारूढो नश्येद् उद् अस्याग्निः सीदेत् पुनराधेयः स्याद् इति या ते अग्ने यज्ञिया तनूस् तयेहि \\ आरोहात्मात्मानम् \ अच्छा वसूनि कृण्वन्न् अस्मे नर्या पुरूणि । \ यज्ञो भूत्वा यज्ञम् आसीद स्वां योनिं जातवेदो भुव आजायमानः सक्षय एहि \\ इत्य् आत्मन् समारोप्य प्रयाति ।
3.8.20.j.m: Now they indeed say: if [the fire] mounted into the kindling sticks should be lost, his fire would perish and would have to be re-established. [Therefore,] having caused [the fire] to mount into himself with the mantra, 'O Agni, with that body of yours which is worthy of sacrifice, come hither, ascend into myself! Providing for us plentiful human goods, becoming sacrifice, sit on the sacrifice, into your own womb, O Jātavedas, being born of the earth, come with your dwelling!', he departs.

3.8.20.k.s: yatra vasati tatra prāg astamayān manthati /
3.8.20.k.d: यत्र वसति तत्र प्राग् अस्तमयान् मन्थति ।
3.8.20.k.m: Wherever he stays, there he churns [the fire] before sunset.

3.8.20.l.s: upāvaroha jātavedaḥ punas tvam \\ devebhyo havyaṃ vahataḥ prajānan / \ āyuḥ prajām̐ rayim asmāsu dhehi \\ ajasro dīdihi no duroṇe \\ ity ātman samārūḍham araṇyor upāvarohya manthati /
3.8.20.l.d: उपावरोह जातवेदः पुनस् त्वम् \\ देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतः प्रजानन् । \ आयुः प्रजाम्̐ रयिम् अस्मासु धेहि \\ अजस्रो दीदिहि नो दुरोणे \\ इत्य् आत्मन् समारूढम् अरण्योर् उपावरोह्य मन्थति ।
3.8.20.l.m: With the mantra, 'Descend again, O Jātavedas, knowingly conveying the offering to the gods; bestow upon us life, offspring, [and] wealth; shine unceasingly in our dwelling,' having brought down into the kindling sticks [the fire] that had mounted into himself, he churns.

3.8.20.m.m: Or having brought a worldly fire, he causes [the fire] to descend into it.

3.8.20.n.s: idam̐ śreyo 'vasānaṃ yad agāt \ syono me dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām / \ anamīvāḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam \\ gomad dhanavad aśvavad dhiraṇyavat puruṣavat suvīravat svāhā \\ ity avasite juhoti /
3.8.20.n.d: इदम्̐ श्रेयो ऽवसानं यद् अगात् \ स्योनो मे द्यावापृथिवी अभूताम् । \ अनमीवाः प्रदिशः सन्तु मह्यम् \\ गोमद् धनवद् अश्ववद् धिरण्यवत् पुरुषवत् सुवीरवत् स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अवसिते जुहोति ।
3.8.20.n.m: When he has settled down, he offers with the mantra, 'This better dwelling that has arrived; may heaven and earth be auspicious to me; may the quarters be free of disease for me, rich in cattle, rich in wealth, rich in horses, rich in gold, rich in men, rich in valiant heroes, svāhā!'

3.8.20.p.s: juhotīti codyamāne darvihomo yatra ca svāhākāraḥ /
3.8.20.p.d: जुहोतीति चोद्यमाने दर्विहोमो यत्र च स्वाहाकारः ।
3.8.20.p.m: Where it is prescribed, 'He offers,' that is a ladle-offering, and also where there is the utterance 'svāhā'.

3.8.20.q.s: tām̐s tūṣṇīkenājyena sakṛdgṛhītenāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītya dakṣiṇatas tiṣṭhañ juhvāhavanīye 'dhvaryuḥ svāhākāreṇa juhoti /
3.8.20.q.d: ताम्̐स् तूष्णीकेनाज्येन सकृद्गृहीतेनाग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्य दक्षिणतस् तिष्ठञ् जुह्वाहवनीये ऽध्वर्युः स्वाहाकारेण जुहोति ।
3.8.20.q.m: With clarified butter taken once silently, having gone around in front of the āhavanīya fire and standing to the south, the adhvaryu offers in the āhavanīya fire with the juhū ladle, with the utterance 'svāhā'.

3.8.20.r.s: dviprabhṛtyāhutigaṇeṣu pratyāhuti gṛhītvā pratyāhuti samidho 'bhyādhāya vigrāhaṃ juhoti /
3.8.20.r.d: द्विप्रभृत्याहुतिगणेषु प्रत्याहुति गृहीत्वा प्रत्याहुति समिधो ऽभ्याधाय विग्राहं जुहोति ।
3.8.20.r.m: In groups of offerings starting from two, having scooped [the butter] for each offering, and having placed on a piece of firewood for each offering, he offers separately.

3.8.20.s.s: yatra mantragaṇena karma codayet pratimantraṃ tatra juhuyāt /
3.8.20.s.d: यत्र मन्त्रगणेन कर्म चोदयेत् प्रतिमन्त्रं तत्र जुहुयात् ।
3.8.20.s.m: Where a rite is prescribed with a group of mantras, he should offer there for each mantra.

3.8.20.t.m: We shall explain the locations [meant] by the word 'he offers'.

3.8.20.u.s: svakṛta iriṇe pradare darbhastambe sthāṇāv iti //
3.8.20.u.d: स्वकृत इरिणे प्रदरे दर्भस्तम्बे स्थाणाव् इति ॥
3.8.20.u.m: In a natural cleft, a fissure, a clump of darbha grass, [or] on a tree stump.

3.8.21.a.d: आहवनीयापनयो ऽनग्नौ तस्मिन्न् एव देशे जुहोति ।
3.8.21.a.m: When the āhavanīya fire is removed, he offers in that very place [even] without fire.

3.8.21.b.s: dārśapaurṇamāsikāni pradhānāny uttarasyāṃ tatau codyante 'nyatra somād dharmād darvihomebhyaś ca /
3.8.21.b.d: दार्शपौर्णमासिकानि प्रधानान्य् उत्तरस्यां ततौ चोद्यन्ते ऽन्यत्र सोमाद् धर्माद् दर्विहोमेभ्यश् च ।
3.8.21.b.m: The primary rites of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are prescribed for the subsequent ritual extension, except for the soma ritual, the pravargya rite, and the ladle-offerings.

3.8.21.f.s: devatāsāmānyena haviḥsāmānyena vā yatra haviḥ pradīyate /
3.8.21.f.d: देवतासामान्येन हविःसामान्येन वा यत्र हविः प्रदीयते ।
3.8.21.f.m: Where an oblation is offered, [similarity is established] by commonality of deity or commonality of sacrificial oblation.

3.8.21.g.m: In case of conflict, commonality of sacrificial oblation is stronger.

3.8.21.h.m: As [in the case of] a sacrificial cake for Viṣṇu.

3.8.21.i.s: ekadevatās tv āgneyavikārā anyatra prakṛtidevatābhyo yathā saumyaś carur aindraḥ puroḍāśa iti /
3.8.21.i.d: एकदेवतास् त्व् आग्नेयविकारा अन्यत्र प्रकृतिदेवताभ्यो यथा सौम्यश् चरुर् ऐन्द्रः पुरोडाश इति ।
3.8.21.i.m: However, [rites with] a single deity are modifications of the Agni offering, except for the archetypal deities; as, for example, the cooked rice offering to Soma, [or] the sacrificial cake offering to Indra.

3.8.21.j.m: Then the other [rites are modifications] of [the offering] to Agni-Soma or to Indra-Agni.

3.8.21.k.s: prakṛtau viśiṣṭadharmāṇām uttarasyāṃ tatau samavetānām aṅgavipratiṣedhe mukhyatvaṃ balīyaḥ /
3.8.21.k.d: प्रकृतौ विशिष्टधर्माणाम् उत्तरस्यां ततौ समवेतानाम् अङ्गविप्रतिषेधे मुख्यत्वं बलीयः ।
3.8.21.k.m: In the archetype, when specific rules come together in the subsequent ritual extension, if there is a conflict among subsidiaries, primacy of the main rite is stronger.

3.8.21.l.m: Prevalence of number is stronger than primacy.

3.8.21.q.s: darśapūrṇamāsayor vikṛteś ca saṃnipāte darśapūrṇamāsau balīyām̐sau /
3.8.21.q.d: दर्शपूर्णमासयोर् विकृतेश् च संनिपाते दर्शपूर्णमासौ बलीयाम्̐सौ ।
3.8.21.q.m: When the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices and a modification coincide, the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are stronger.

3.8.21.r.m: However, whatever rules are directly taught for the iṣṭis and animal sacrifices belong there [in those rites].

3.8.21.s.s: darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtaya iṣṭipaśubandhās te svadharmāṇaḥ sāmānyād vikāraḥ /
3.8.21.s.d: दर्शपूर्णमासप्रकृतय इष्टिपशुबन्धास् ते स्वधर्माणः सामान्याद् विकारः ।
3.8.21.s.m: The iṣṭis and animal sacrifices have the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices as their archetype; they have their own procedural rules, [and] the modified form [derives] from similarity.

3.8.21.t.s: karmasaṃyuktāni dravyāṇi prakṛtau tatsaṃyogād dharmaṃ labhante karmaṇy avidyamāne sahadharmadravyaṃ nivartate /
3.8.21.t.d: कर्मसंयुक्तानि द्रव्याणि प्रकृतौ तत्संयोगाद् धर्मं लभन्ते कर्मण्य् अविद्यमाने सहधर्मद्रव्यं निवर्तते ।
3.8.21.t.m: Substances connected with a rite acquire procedural rules in the archetype through that connection; when the rite is absent, the substance together with its procedural rules ceases.

3.8.21.u.m: As, for instance, pounding in the case of gold pieces.

3.8.21.v.s: anyasmim̐ś ca dravye tenārthena saṃyujyamāne dharmāveśaḥ /
3.8.21.v.d: अन्यस्मिम्̐श् च द्रव्ये तेनार्थेन संयुज्यमाने धर्मावेशः ।
3.8.21.v.m: And when another substance is joined for the same purpose, there is transference of procedural rules.

3.8.21.w.m: The procedural rule of potsherds [applies] to a cooking pot; the procedural rule of rice [applies] to millet.

3.8.21.x.m: When [a rite] is prohibited at the origin of the sacrifice, everything [connected to it] would be prohibited.

3.8.21.y.m: They do not erect a sacrificial post, nor do they scatter the high altar.

3.8.21.z.s: anyasmim̐ś ca dravye tenārthena saṃyujyamāne dharmāveṣa utkare vājinam āsādayanty aśve paśūn niyuñjanti paridhau paśūn niyuñjanti /
3.8.21.z.d: अन्यस्मिम्̐श् च द्रव्ये तेनार्थेन संयुज्यमाने धर्मावेष उत्करे वाजिनम् आसादयन्त्य् अश्वे पशून् नियुञ्जन्ति परिधौ पशून् नियुञ्जन्ति ।
3.8.21.z.m: And when another substance is joined for that purpose, there is transference of procedural rules: they place the whey on the rubbish heap; they tether the sacrificial animals to a horse; they tether the sacrificial animals to an enclosing stick.

3.8.22.a.m: the sticks of firewood increase; when they are reduced, [they remain] as in the archetype.

3.8.22.c.m: There is no adaptation in the archetype.

3.8.22.d.d: पत्नीम्̐ संनह्य \\ उपहूतो ऽयं यजमानस् \\ इति ।
3.8.22.d.m: [For example,] having girded the sacrificer's wife, [the formula remains,] 'Called is this sacrificer.'

3.8.22.e.m: Likewise, in the subsequent ritual extension, [it is applied] just as handed down.

3.8.22.f.s: pratinidhiṣv arthaluptāni na kriyeran yathā lūne lavanamantracchinne chedanamantraḥ /
3.8.22.f.d: प्रतिनिधिष्व् अर्थलुप्तानि न क्रियेरन् यथा लूने लवनमन्त्रच्छिन्ने छेदनमन्त्रः ।
3.8.22.f.m: In the case of substitutes, those whose purpose is lost should not be performed, as the cutting mantra when [the grass] is already cut, or the severing mantra when [the wood] is already severed.

3.8.22.g.s: yatra payaḥ śrapaṇārthena śrūyate devas tvā savitotpunātu \\ ity utpavanaṃ saṃnamati payo devāgreṣv agra ity abhimantraṇam evam ājye /
3.8.22.g.d: यत्र पयः श्रपणार्थेन श्रूयते देवस् त्वा सवितोत्पुनातु \\ इत्य् उत्पवनं संनमति पयो देवाग्रेष्व् अग्र इत्य् अभिमन्त्रणम् एवम् आज्ये ।
3.8.22.g.m: Where milk is prescribed for cooking: the [mantra for] purification, "May god Savitṛ purify you...", is adapted, [and] the address is "O milk, first among the gods..." Likewise in the case of clarified butter.

3.8.22.h.m: We shall explain the procedures for the caru oblation.

3.8.22.i.m: He employs a pot in place of the potsherds.

3.8.22.j.m: Its [procedure] is established [from the general rule] up to the de-husked grains.

3.8.22.k.m: Having put the pot on [the fire] with the first potsherd mantra,

3.8.22.l.s: śūrpād eva taṇḍulān samopyotpūyādhiśrayaṇamantreṇopya paryagni kṛtvā śrapayitvābhighārya sthālyaivodvāsayati /
3.8.22.l.d: शूर्पाद् एव तण्डुलान् समोप्योत्पूयाधिश्रयणमन्त्रेणोप्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा श्रपयित्वाभिघार्य स्थाल्यैवोद्वासयति ।
3.8.22.l.m: having poured the rice grains together directly from the winnowing basket, purified [them], poured them into [the pot] with the mantra for setting on the fire, carried fire around [it], cooked [it], basted [it with clarified butter], he takes it off [the fire] in the pot itself.

3.8.22.m.m: In a group of sacrificial cakes, by means of a sacrificial cake:

3.8.22.n.s: yathābhāgaṃ vyāvartadhvam ity ekaikaṃ piṇḍam apacchinatti yathābhāgaṃ vyāvartethām ity avaśiṣṭau /
3.8.22.n.d: यथाभागं व्यावर्तध्वम् इत्य् एकैकं पिण्डम् अपच्छिनत्ति यथाभागं व्यावर्तेथाम् इत्य् अवशिष्टौ ।
3.8.22.n.m: He divides each single lump with "Separate according to your portion"; the remaining two with "Separate both of you according to your portions."

3.8.22.o.m: The assignment of deity belongs only to the two of them.

3.8.22.p.s: carupuroḍāśyān prāg adhivapanād vibhajyeram̐s tatra vibhāgamantraṃ japati samān dvaidhaṃ karoti viṣamān yathābhāgam /
3.8.22.p.d: चरुपुरोडाश्यान् प्राग् अधिवपनाद् विभज्येरम्̐स् तत्र विभागमन्त्रं जपति समान् द्वैधं करोति विषमान् यथाभागम् ।
3.8.22.p.m: The materials for the caru and the sacrificial cake should be divided before pouring onto [the grinding stone]; there he mutters the division mantra; he makes equal [portions into] two parts, unequal [portions] according to their share.

3.8.22.q.s: idam amuṣmai cāmuṣmai ca \\ ity ekaikasmin rāśāv ekaikāṃ devatām upalakṣayet /
3.8.22.q.d: इदम् अमुष्मै चामुष्मै च \\ इत्य् एकैकस्मिन् राशाव् एकैकां देवताम् उपलक्षयेत् ।
3.8.22.q.m: He should indicate each single deity for each single heap with, "This for so-and-so, and [this] for so-and-so."

3.8.22.r.m: Having cut off the portion for Pūṣan, he grinds [it] together with the materials for the sacrificial cake.

3.8.22.s.m: At the time of setting on [the fire], they should be divided from one another.

3.8.22.t.m: There he mutters the division mantra.

3.8.22.u.s: nānābījeṣu samaveteṣv ekam ulūkhalaṃ musalam̐ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca /
3.8.22.u.d: नानाबीजेषु समवेतेष्व् एकम् उलूखलं मुसलम्̐ शूर्पं कृष्णाजिनं च ।
3.8.22.u.m: When different types of grains are combined, there are [only] one mortar, pestle, winnowing basket, and black antelope skin.

3.8.22.v.s: prathame bīje haviṣkṛtam āhvayaty uttame vācaṃ visṛjate /
3.8.22.v.d: प्रथमे बीजे हविष्कृतम् आह्वयत्य् उत्तमे वाचं विसृजते ।
3.8.22.v.m: At the first grain, he calls the preparer of the oblation; at the last, he releases his speech.

3.8.22.w.s: somenāgrayaṇeṣṭyā paśubandhena vāmāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta /
3.8.22.w.d: सोमेनाग्रयणेष्ट्या पशुबन्धेन वामावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां वा यजेत ।
3.8.22.w.m: He may sacrifice on the New Moon or Full Moon day with Soma, with the first-fruits sacrifice (āgrāyaṇeṣṭi), or with an animal sacrifice.

3.8.22.x.s: saptadaśānubrūyād iṣṭyāḥ paśubandhasya vā pañcadaśabhir vikalperann avikalpo vā //
3.8.22.x.d: सप्तदशानुब्रूयाद् इष्ट्याः पशुबन्धस्य वा पञ्चदशभिर् विकल्पेरन्न् अविकल्पो वा ॥
3.8.22.x.m: He should recite seventeen [kindling verses] for the iṣṭi or the animal sacrifice, or they may alternate with fifteen, or there is no alternation.

3.8.23.a.m: We shall explain the first-fruits sacrifice (āgrāyaṇeṣṭi).

3.8.23.b.s: tayā nāniṣṭvā navānām oṣadhīnāṃ phalāny aśnāti grāmyāṇām āraṇyānāṃ ca /
3.8.23.b.d: तया नानिष्ट्वा नवानाम् ओषधीनां फलान्य् अश्नाति ग्राम्याणाम् आरण्यानां च ।
3.8.23.b.m: Without having sacrificed with it, he does not eat the fruits of new plants, both cultivated and wild.

3.8.23.c.s: vrīhīṇām agrapākasya yajate tathā śyāmākānaṃ yavānām agrapākasya yajate /
3.8.23.c.d: व्रीहीणाम् अग्रपाकस्य यजते तथा श्यामाकानं यवानाम् अग्रपाकस्य यजते ।
3.8.23.c.m: He sacrifices with the first ripened rice; likewise he sacrifices with the first ripened wild rice (śyāmāka) and barley.

3.8.23.d.s: tathā vrīhīṇāṃ nirvapaṇakāle purāṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati navānām itarāṇi /
3.8.23.d.d: तथा व्रीहीणां निर्वपणकाले पुराणानां व्रीहीणाम् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति नवानाम् इतराणि ।
3.8.23.d.m: Likewise, at the time of pouring out the rice, he pours out [an oblation] on eight potsherds to Agni made of old rice, and the others of new [rice]:

3.8.23.e.s: āgnendram aindrāgnaṃ vā dvādaśakapālaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ payasi śṛtam̐ saumyam̐ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ dyāvāpṛthivyam ekakapālam /
3.8.23.e.d: आग्नेन्द्रम् ऐन्द्राग्नं वा द्वादशकपालं वैश्वदेवं चरुं पयसि शृतम्̐ सौम्यम्̐ श्यामाकं चरुं द्यावापृथिव्यम् एककपालम् ।
3.8.23.e.m: an oblation on twelve potsherds to Indra-Agni or Agni-Indra, a caru to the Viśvedevas cooked in milk, a śyāmāka caru to Soma, and an oblation on a single potsherd to Heaven and Earth.

3.8.23.f.m: Some teach that the śyāmāka [caru has] a separate framework.

3.8.23.g.s: upasanne haviṣyaprokṣite śatāyudhāya \\ iti pañcājyānīr juhoti /
3.8.23.g.d: उपसन्ने हविष्यप्रोक्षिते शतायुधाय \\ इति पञ्चाज्यानीर् जुहोति ।
3.8.23.g.m: When the sacrificial oblation has been set down and sprinkled, he offers five clarified butter oblations with "To him who has a hundred weapons..."

3.8.23.h.m: Some teach [these to be offered] before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

3.8.23.i.m: The procedure for [oblations on] a single potsherd has been explained by the single potsherd oblation to the Viśvedevas.

3.8.23.k.m: He does not offer over it with the names of the months.

3.8.23.l.s: vrīhibhir iṣṭvā vrīhibhir eva yajetāyavebhyo yavair iṣṭvā yavair eva yajetāvrīhibhyaḥ /
3.8.23.l.d: व्रीहिभिर् इष्ट्वा व्रीहिभिर् एव यजेतायवेभ्यो यवैर् इष्ट्वा यवैर् एव यजेताव्रीहिभ्यः ।
3.8.23.l.m: Having sacrificed with rice, he should sacrifice only with rice until the barley [ripens]; having sacrificed with barley, he should sacrifice only with barley until the rice [ripens].

3.8.23.m.m: Some teach [an offering of] bamboo seeds [instead of] śyāmāka.

3.8.23.n.s: api vā nāgrayaṇeṣṭiṃ kurvīta navair evāmāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta /
3.8.23.n.d: अपि वा नाग्रयणेष्टिं कुर्वीत नवैर् एवामावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां वा यजेत ।
3.8.23.n.m: Or rather, he need not perform the first-fruits sacrifice: he may sacrifice on the New Moon or Full Moon day with the new [grains] themselves.

3.8.23.o.s: navair vāgnihotraṃ juhuyād agnihotrīṃ vā navān ādayitvā tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa juhuyāc catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ vā paktvāgrayaṇadevatābhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛccaturthībhyo hutvā tadvyañjanaṃ bhojayati bhojayati //
3.8.23.o.d: नवैर् वाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाद् अग्निहोत्रीं वा नवान् आदयित्वा तस्याः क्षीरेण जुहुयाच् चतुःशरावम् ओदनं वा पक्त्वाग्रयणदेवताभ्यः स्विष्टकृच्चतुर्थीभ्यो हुत्वा तद्व्यञ्जनं भोजयति भोजयति ॥
3.8.23.o.m: Or he may offer the Agnihotra with the new [grains], or having fed the new [grains] to the Agnihotra cow, he may offer with her milk, or having cooked a four-śarāva mess of boiled rice, having offered to the first-fruits deities with Sviṣṭakṛt as the fourth, he feeds [the priests] with sauces made from it; he feeds [them].

4.1.1.a.s: aindrāgnena paśunā ṣāṇmāsyeṣāṇmāsye yajata āvṛttimukhaāvṛttimukhe saṃvatsaresaṃvatsare vā /
4.1.1.a.d: ऐन्द्राग्नेन पशुना षाण्मास्येषाण्मास्ये यजत आवृत्तिमुखआवृत्तिमुखे संवत्सरेसंवत्सरे वा ।
4.1.1.a.m: He sacrifices with an animal for Indra-Agni every six months, at each change of the sun's course, or every year;

4.1.1.d.s: sūryaṃ te cakṣus \\ iti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ manasānudrutya sagraham̐ hutvānvārambhaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
4.1.1.d.d: सूर्यं ते चक्षुस् \\ इति षड्ढोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य सग्रहम्̐ हुत्वान्वारम्भणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति ।
4.1.1.d.m: Having mentally recited the six-hotṛ formula, "May Sūrya be your eye...", and offered [the oblation] with the cup formula, he pours out the preparatory sacrifice (anvārambhaṇīyā iṣṭi):

4.1.1.e.m: [an oblation] on eleven potsherds to Agni-Viṣṇu.

4.1.1.g.s: api vā caturgṛhītam ājyam āgnāvaiṣṇavayarcāhavanīye juhoti /
4.1.1.g.d: अपि वा चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यम् आग्नावैष्णवयर्चाहवनीये जुहोति ।
4.1.1.g.m: Or rather, he offers clarified butter taken in four ladlings into the āhavanīya fire with a verse to Agni-Viṣṇu.

4.1.1.h.m: He keeps a remnant of the clarified butter; he keeps the āhavanīya fire burning.

4.1.1.i.s: uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ iti sruveṇāhavanīye yūpāhutiṃ juhoti /
4.1.1.i.d: उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इति स्रुवेणाहवनीये यूपाहुतिं जुहोति ।
4.1.1.i.m: With "Stride out widely, O Viṣṇu...", he offers the sacrificial post offering into the āhavanīya fire with the dipping spoon.

4.1.1.j.s: ājyaśeṣaṃ sruvaṃ cādatte takṣṇe paraśuṃ prayacchati tad gacchanti yatra yūpaṃ chetsyanto bhavanti /
4.1.1.j.d: आज्यशेषं स्रुवं चादत्ते तक्ष्णे परशुं प्रयच्छति तद् गच्छन्ति यत्र यूपं छेत्स्यन्तो भवन्ति ।
4.1.1.j.m: He takes the remnant of clarified butter and the dipping spoon, gives the axe to the carpenter, [and] they go to where they are to cut the sacrificial post.

4.1.1.k.s: pālāśaḥ khādiro bailvo rauhītakaś ca yūpyā vṛkṣāḥ /
4.1.1.k.d: पालाशः खादिरो बैल्वो रौहीतकश् च यूप्या वृक्षाः ।
4.1.1.k.m: Trees suitable for a sacrificial post are: palāśa, khadira, bilva, and rohitaka.

4.1.1.l.s: pālāśaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasyānnādyakāmasya vā khādiram̐ svargakāmasya bailvaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya rauhītakaṃ prajākāmasya /
4.1.1.l.d: पालाशं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्यान्नाद्यकामस्य वा खादिरम्̐ स्वर्गकामस्य बैल्वं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य रौहीतकं प्रजाकामस्य ।
4.1.1.l.m: A palāśa [post is] for one who desires spiritual lustre or food; a khadira [post] for one who desires heaven; a bilva [post] for one who desires spiritual lustre; a rohitaka [post] for one who desires offspring.

4.1.1.m.m: Having passed by at least three trees suitable for a sacrificial post,

4.1.1.n.s: ya ṛjur ūrdhva ūrdhvaśakala ūrdhvaśākhaḥ same bhūmyai svād yone rūḍhaḥ /
4.1.1.n.d: य ऋजुर् ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्वशकल ऊर्ध्वशाखः समे भूम्यै स्वाद् योने रूढः ।
4.1.1.n.m: [he selects one] which is straight, lofty, with upward-tending bark, upward-tending branches, [and] which has grown in a level place of the earth from its own origin.

4.1.1.o.s: yaṃ kāmayetāpratiṣṭhitaḥ syād ity ārohaṃ tasmai vṛśced yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparṇaṃ tasmai śuṣkāgraṃ kāmayeta paśumān syād iti bahuparṇaṃ tasmai bahuśākham aśuṣkāgram /
4.1.1.o.d: यं कामयेताप्रतिष्ठितः स्याद् इत्य् आरोहं तस्मै वृश्चेद् यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इत्य् अपर्णं तस्मै शुष्काग्रं कामयेत पशुमान् स्याद् इति बहुपर्णं तस्मै बहुशाखम् अशुष्काग्रम् ।
4.1.1.o.m: For one whom he wishes, "May he be unestablished," he should cut a tree with an offshoot; for one whom he wishes, "May he be without cattle," a leafless tree with a dried-up top; for one whom he wishes, "May he be rich in cattle," a tree rich in leaves, with many branches, and with an undried top;

4.1.1.p.m: a firmly rooted [tree] for one who desires stability.

4.1.1.q.s: yaḥ pratyaṅṅ upanatastaṃ vṛśced yaḥ prāṅṅ udaṅ vopanataḥ /
4.1.1.q.d: यः प्रत्यङ्ङ् उपनतस्तं वृश्चेद् यः प्राङ्ङ् उदङ् वोपनतः ।
4.1.1.q.m: He should cut one that is bent westward, or one that is bent eastward or northward,

4.1.1.r.s: yasya carjoḥ sata īṣad ivāgram upanatam /
4.1.1.r.d: यस्य चर्जोः सत ईषद् इवाग्रम् उपनतम् ।
4.1.1.r.m: and of a straight one, the tip is just slightly bent.

4.1.2.a.m: He stands before the one he prefers.

4.1.2.b.s: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ iti sruveṇa gulphadaghne jānudaghne vā paryaṇakti /
4.1.2.b.d: देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इति स्रुवेण गुल्फदघ्ने जानुदघ्ने वा पर्यणक्ति ।
4.1.2.b.m: With "May god Savitṛ anoint you with honey...", he anoints it all around with the dipping spoon at ankle-height or knee-height.

4.1.2.c.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam ity ūrdhvāgrām oṣadhim antardadhāti svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīs \\ iti paraśunā praharati yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ parāpatati tam upayacchate /
4.1.2.c.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाग्राम् ओषधिम् अन्तर्दधाति स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति परशुना प्रहरति यः प्रथमः शकलः परापतति तम् उपयच्छते ।
4.1.2.c.m: With "O plant, protect him!" he places a blade of grass with its tip pointing upward [against it]; with "O axe, do not harm him!" he strikes with the axe; the first chip that flies off, he catches.

4.1.2.d.s: anakṣasaṅgam̐ sthāṇum ucchim̐ṣan vṛścati gulhadaghnaṃ vā /
4.1.2.d.d: अनक्षसङ्गम्̐ स्थाणुम् उच्छिम्̐षन् वृश्चति गुल्हदघ्नं वा ।
4.1.2.d.m: He cuts it leaving a stump that does not catch an axle, or at ankle-height.

4.1.2.e.s: divam agreṇa \\ iti prāñcam udañcaṃ vā prahāpayati /
4.1.2.e.d: दिवम् अग्रेण \\ इति प्राञ्चम् उदञ्चं वा प्रहापयति ।
4.1.2.e.m: With "With your top [reach] the sky...", he causes it to fall toward the east or toward the north.

4.1.2.f.s: vanaspate śatavalśo viroha \\ ity āvraścane juhoti sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
4.1.2.f.d: वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह \\ इत्य् आव्रश्चने जुहोति सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति ।
4.1.2.f.m: With "O lord of the forest, grow up with a hundred shoots!" he offers [clarified butter] on the stump; with "May we grow up with a thousand shoots!" he touches himself.

4.1.2.g.s: yaṃ tvāyam̐ svadhitis \\ ity anulomaṃ paraśunāṅgān kalpayati /
4.1.2.g.d: यं त्वायम्̐ स्वधितिस् \\ इत्य् अनुलोमं परशुनाङ्गान् कल्पयति ।
4.1.2.g.m: With "Which you this axe...", he trims the limbs along the grain with the axe.

4.1.2.h.s: acchinno rāyaḥ suvīras \\ ity agraṃ parivāsayati /
4.1.2.h.d: अच्छिन्नो रायः सुवीरस् \\ इत्य् अग्रं परिवासयति ।
4.1.2.h.m: With "Undivided wealth with good heroes...", he lops off the top.

4.1.2.i.s: ekāratniprabhṛtīni brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni yūpapramāṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
4.1.2.i.d: एकारत्निप्रभृतीनि ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि यूपप्रमाणानि तेषां याथाकामी ।
4.1.2.i.m: The measurements of the sacrificial post according to desire, beginning from one cubit, have been explained in the Brāhmaṇa; one may act according to one's desire among them.

4.1.2.j.m: The count, along with the portion below ground, may extend up to thirty-three cubits.

4.1.2.k.s: tryaratnir vā caturaratnir vā pālāśo nirūḍhapaśubandhasya yūpo 'to 'nye saumyasyādhvarasya /
4.1.2.k.d: त्र्यरत्निर् वा चतुररत्निर् वा पालाशो निरूढपशुबन्धस्य यूपो ऽतो ऽन्ये सौम्यस्याध्वरस्य ।
4.1.2.k.m: For the independent animal sacrifice, the sacrificial post made of palāśa wood is either three cubits or four cubits [long]; other than that, they belong to the soma sacrifice.

4.1.2.l.s: aṣṭāśriṃ takṣṇoti nātisthūlaṃ nātyaṇum ataṣṭam uparam /
4.1.2.l.d: अष्टाश्रिं तक्ष्णोति नातिस्थूलं नात्यणुम् अतष्टम् उपरम् ।
4.1.2.l.m: He hews it eight-cornered, neither too thick nor too thin, leaving the portion below ground unhewn.

4.1.2.m.m: Tapering forward and forward, or like a cow's tail.

4.1.2.n.m: From the very top of that tree he makes the top-ring.

4.1.2.o.m: Eight-cornered, a span in width, curved inward in the middle.

4.1.2.p.s: yāvad idaṃ prathamam aṅgulikāṇḍaṃ tāvad ūrdhvaṃ caṣālād yūpasyātirecayati /
4.1.2.p.d: यावद् इदं प्रथमम् अङ्गुलिकाण्डं तावद् ऊर्ध्वं चषालाद् यूपस्यातिरेचयति ।
4.1.2.p.m: He leaves protruding above the top-ring as much of the sacrificial post as this first joint of the finger.

4.1.2.q.m: A finger's breadth, or less than a finger's breadth.

4.1.2.r.s: dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ vaiteṣām eva takṣaṇānām̐ svaruṃ karoti /
4.1.2.r.d: द्व्यङ्गुलं त्र्यङ्गुलं चतुरङ्गुलं वैतेषाम् एव तक्षणानाम्̐ स्वरुं करोति ।
4.1.2.r.m: From these very chips he makes a wooden splinter of two fingers' breadth, three fingers' breadth, or four fingers' breadth.

4.1.2.s.s: yaṃ kāmayetānyo 'sya lokam abhyārohed ity anyavṛkṣasya svaruṃ caṣālaṃ ca kuryāt /
4.1.2.s.d: यं कामयेतान्यो ऽस्य लोकम् अभ्यारोहेद् इत्य् अन्यवृक्षस्य स्वरुं चषालं च कुर्यात् ।
4.1.2.s.m: If he should desire: 'Let another person mount over this one's world,' he should make the wooden splinter and the top-ring from a different tree.

4.1.2.t.m: Having fashioned the veda in front of the āhavanīya fire,

4.1.3.a.m: he makes the altar as large as a chariot.

4.1.3.b.s: ratheṣāmātrīṃ prācīṃ rathākṣamātrīṃ paścāttiraścīṃ vipathayugamātrīṃ purastādudīcīm /
4.1.3.b.d: रथेषामात्रीं प्राचीं रथाक्षमात्रीं पश्चात्तिरश्चीं विपथयुगमात्रीं पुरस्तादुदीचीम् ।
4.1.3.b.m: Measuring the length of a chariot-pole toward the east, measuring the length of a chariot-axle across at the back, and measuring the length of an open-chariot yoke across at the front toward the north.

4.1.3.c.s: api vā ṣaḍaratniṃ prācīṃ caturaratniṃ paścāttiraścīṃ tryaratniṃ purastāttiraścīm asaṃnatā bhavati /
4.1.3.c.d: अपि वा षडरत्निं प्राचीं चतुररत्निं पश्चात्तिरश्चीं त्र्यरत्निं पुरस्तात्तिरश्चीम् असंनता भवति ।
4.1.3.c.m: Or rather, measuring six cubits toward the east, measuring four cubits across at the back, and measuring three cubits across at the front; it does not curve inward.

4.1.3.d.s: yat prāguttarasmāt parigrāhāt tat kṛtvā pūrvārdhe veder yūpāvaṭāyāvakāśam avaśiṣya śamyayottaravediṃ vimimīte /
4.1.3.d.d: यत् प्रागुत्तरस्मात् परिग्राहात् तत् कृत्वा पूर्वार्धे वेदेर् यूपावटायावकाशम् अवशिष्य शम्ययोत्तरवेदिं विमिमीते ।
4.1.3.d.m: Having performed that which is prior to the northern enclosing-trace, leaving space for the post-hole in the eastern half of the altar, he measures out the high altar with the yoke-pin.

4.1.3.e.s: purastād ucīcīnakumbām̐ śamyāṃ nidhāya vittāyanī me 'si \\ iti sphyenodīcīṃ lekhāṃ likhati /
4.1.3.e.d: पुरस्ताद् उचीचीनकुम्बाम्̐ शम्यां निधाय वित्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति स्फ्येनोदीचीं लेखां लिखति ।
4.1.3.e.m: Having placed the yoke-pin in front with its peg-point facing north, he draws a line to the north with the wooden sword, with the mantra: 'You are the finder of wealth for me.'

4.1.3.f.s: dakṣiṇataḥprācīnakumbāṃ nidhāya tiktāyanī me 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥprācīṃ paścādudīcīnakumbāṃ nidhāya \\ avatān mā nāthitam iti paścādudīcīmuttarataḥ prācīnakumbāṃ nidhāya \\ avatān mā vyathitam ity uttarataḥ prācīm abhyantaraṃ parilikhati /
4.1.3.f.d: दक्षिणतःप्राचीनकुम्बां निधाय तिक्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणतःप्राचीं पश्चादुदीचीनकुम्बां निधाय \\ अवतान् मा नाथितम् इति पश्चादुदीचीमुत्तरतः प्राचीनकुम्बां निधाय \\ अवतान् मा व्यथितम् इत्य् उत्तरतः प्राचीम् अभ्यन्तरं परिलिखति ।
